title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 16 项，AI × Bio 13 项，AI × Math 16 项，AI Voices 10 项，Engineering 8 项。今日五频道共同日期为 2026-10-15。内容以预印本和公开观点为主：AI×Chem 聚焦生成式分子设计、药物发现代理与逆合成；AI×Bio 涵盖乳腺癌预后、创伤性脑损伤血脑屏障和超增强子调控；AI×Math 讨论形式化验证与协作推理。AI Voices 汇总 X 公开帖，Engineering 则是 GitHub Trending 项目快照。所列论文均为预印本，未见同行评议论文；工程条目也不等同于今日软件新版本发布。

channel_highlights.aixchem: 三篇均为预印本：LasB 抑制剂工作结合生成设计、自由能计算与实验验证；MADDIE 做多代理药物发现；RetroRLFF 以前向反馈改进逆合成。
channel_highlights.aixbio: 三篇均为预印本：研究多模态乳腺癌预后、创伤后微血栓与 Cav-1 血脑屏障机制，以及从 DNA 序列解码超增强子调控。
channel_highlights.aixmath: 三篇均为 arXiv 预印本：覆盖 TLA+–Verus 时序证明、机械检查的 Lean 自动形式化，以及协作推理模型的 Shapley 评估与训练。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 这是 X 公开帖而非论文：内容涉及 LLM-to-Flow 分子生成、物理知识辅助反事实预测和 UI 设计创造力基准；数字均为帖文自述。
channel_highlights.engineering: 这是 GitHub Trending 快照，不等同软件新版本发布：REA 做代理辅助逆向工程，VoiceStudio 做本地语音克隆与配音，mksglu 优化编码代理上下文。

items.title: Prospective discovery of LasB inhibitors by integrating generative design, free energy ranking, and experimental validation
items.abstract_or_text: Identifying synthetically accessible, potent ligands from vast chemical space remains a major challenge in drug discovery, particularly because experimental synthesis and testing are costly and low throughput. Here, we present a fully open-source computational-experimental workflow that integrates fragment-based de novo molecular design with rigorous alchemical absolute binding free-energy calculations to enable physics-based prioritization before chemical synthesis. We apply this strategy by targeting the virulence-associated zinc metalloprotease LasB from Pseudomonas aeruginosa. From ~40,000 diverse compounds generated through multi-objective optimization, a small subset was prioritized and experimentally evaluated, leading to the discovery of three previously unreported nanomolar inhibitors (IC50 22-53 nM) with excellent metabolic and plasma stability. This work demonstrates a general and scalable framework for coupling generative molecular design with quantitative binding affinity prediction, improving decision-making and reducing the cost, time, and risk associated with early-stage drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 提出开源计算—实验一体化流程，将片段式从头分子设计与严格的绝对结合自由能计算结合，用于筛选 LasB 抑制剂；从约40,000个候选中优先合成测试，发现3个此前未报道的纳摩尔级抑制剂。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 有前瞻性实验验证，直接展示生成设计和自由能排序如何缩小合成范围；但结果针对单一靶点，规模化适用性和更广泛的体内药效仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 从庞大的化学空间中识别具有合成可及性和高效力的配体是药物发现中的主要挑战，尤其是实验合成和测试成本高、通量低。我们提出一种完全开源的计算—实验流程，将基于片段的从头分子设计与严格的代数绝对结合自由能计算相结合，在化学合成前进行基于物理的优先级排序。我们以铜绿假单胞菌的毒力相关锌金属蛋白酶 LasB 为靶点应用该策略。从通过多目标优化生成的约40,000个多样化化合物中，我们优先选择少量候选进行实验评估，发现了3个此前未报道的纳摩尔级抑制剂（IC50 22-53 nM），并且具有优异的代谢稳定性和血浆稳定性。该工作展示了将生成式分子设计与定量结合亲和力预测相结合的通用且可扩展框架，有助于改善早期药物发现中的决策，并降低成本、时间和风险。
items.author_line: Martinez Leon, A., Vgenopoulou, A., Jezequel, G., Kany, A. M., Hirsch, A. K., Hub, J. S.

items.title: MADDIE: Multi-Agent Drug Discovery Engine
items.abstract_or_text: Drug discovery remains a resource-intensive and time-consuming process, involving billions of dollars and a decade of development to advance a drug to market. While many in silico tools have accelerated this process, operating them still demands substantial time, effort, and expertise from medicinal chemists. Autonomous systems built on Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a promising solution, yet current designs limit their performance. Existing single-agent systems scale poorly to long-horizon, multi-step, and realistic tasks, whereas multi-agent systems typically execute predefined workflows that cannot capture the iterative, non-linear nature of a real drug discovery campaign. Here, we present MADDIE, a multi-agent drug discovery engine. It comprises a central agent, Orchestrator, and four specialized worker agents: HitIdentifier, LeadOptimizer, Synthesizer, and Evaluator, each representing a critical step in a drug discovery campaign. Under Orchestrator's orchestration and coordination, these worker agents are composed into flexible workflows, enabling MADDIE to adapt its strategy and navigate the drug discovery pipeline end-to-end. Across 50 protein targets, MADDIE produces molecules satisfying key property requirements and their synthesis routes, outperforming existing agentic systems, generative models, and general-purpose LLMs by a wide margin. Our analysis reveals how these agents collaborate and that MADDIE can employ different strategies across targets to achieve the campaign's goal, while still being efficient in time and tokens. Together, they demonstrate MADDIE as a low-cost, effective, and efficient autonomous engine for accelerating drug discovery. Code and dataset is available via https://github.com/ninglab/MADDIE.
items.summary_zh: 构建多智能体药物发现引擎 MADDIE，由 Orchestrator 协调 HitIdentifier、LeadOptimizer、Synthesizer 和 Evaluator 四类专门智能体，在50个蛋白靶点上完成分子设计与合成路线规划。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖从命中识别到合成评估的端到端流程，并报告在50个靶点上的系统比较；不过证据主要来自计算基准，尚不能替代真实合成和药理实验。
items.abstract_zh: 药物发现仍然是资源密集且耗时的过程，一种药物从研发到上市需要投入数十亿美元并历经十年。尽管许多计算机模拟工具已加速这一过程，但操作这些工具仍需要药物化学家投入大量时间、精力和专业知识。基于大型语言模型（LLM）构建的自主系统已成为一种有前景的解决方案，但当前设计限制了其性能。现有单智能体系统难以扩展到长期、多步骤和真实的任务，而多智能体系统通常执行预定义工作流，无法捕捉真实药物发现项目的迭代性和非线性。为此，我们提出多智能体药物发现引擎 MADDIE。它由一个中央智能体 Orchestrator 和四个专门的工作智能体组成：HitIdentifier、LeadOptimizer、Synthesizer 和 Evaluator，分别代表药物发现项目中的关键步骤。在 Orchestrator 的编排和协调下，这些工作智能体可组成灵活工作流，使 MADDIE 能够调整策略并端到端地遍历药物发现流程。在50个蛋白靶点上，MADDIE 生成了满足关键性质要求的分子及其合成路线，并以较大幅度优于已有智能体系统、生成模型和通用 LLM。我们的分析揭示了这些智能体如何协作，以及 MADDIE 如何针对不同靶点采用不同策略来实现项目目标，同时保持时间和 token 效率。总体而言，这些结果表明 MADDIE 是一种低成本、有效且高效的自主引擎，可用于加速药物发现。代码和数据集见 https://github.com/ninglab/MADDIE。
items.author_line: Ye Liu, Reza Averly, Avery Meyer, Frazier N. Baker, Ruoxi Gao, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Xia Ning

items.title: Single-step Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback
items.abstract_or_text: Single-step retrosynthesis is a one-to-many inverse problem, yet most models are trained and evaluated against a single recorded reactant set. Reference-based training gives no explicit positive signal for unrecorded alternatives, and exact-match evaluation rejects non-matching predictions regardless of chemical plausibility. We propose Retrosynthesis via Reinforcement Learning from Forward Feedback (RetroRLFF), which optimizes reactant generation using both reference agreement and forward consistency with the target product. Starting from a supervised decoder-only Transformer, RetroRLFF generates complete reactant candidates and uses a frozen forward reaction model to predict products. A sequence-level reward combines reference agreement and forward consistency while penalizing invalid outputs. Direct Advantage-Based Policy Optimization updates the policy without human preference annotations or a preference-trained reward model. On USPTO-50K, RetroRLFF outperforms all 14 baselines in candidate-level round-trip accuracy at k = 1, 3, 5, and 10. With approximately 50 million parameters, it achieves 90.1% top-1 round-trip accuracy, exceeding R-SMILES, the strongest competing baseline on this metric, by 8.5 percentage points. Compared with its supervised policy, round-trip accuracy increases from 83.1% to 90.1%, while exact-match accuracy is maintained at 57.9% versus 57.5%. In an anonymized expert assessment of 131 randomly selected test cases, organic synthesis experts prefer RetroRLFF over EditRetro in 67.9% of comparisons. These results support forward feedback as a training signal for improving forward consistency while retaining top-1 reference recovery. Expert assessment provides complementary evidence of synthetic feasibility on the selected cases, although neither forward consistency nor expert preference establishes experimental feasibility.
items.summary_zh: 提出 RetroRLFF，在单步逆合成中同时利用参考反应一致性和冻结正向反应模型的反馈，通过序列级强化学习生成更符合化学可行性的反应物集合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 USPTO-50K 上以约5,000万参数取得90.1%的 top-1 往返准确率，并有专家偏好评估；但正向一致性和专家偏好仍不能证明真实实验可行性。
items.abstract_zh: 单步逆合成是一个一对多的逆问题，但大多数模型都针对单一记录的反应物集合进行训练和评估。基于参考答案的训练不会对未记录的替代方案提供明确的正向信号，而精确匹配评估无论预测是否具有化学合理性，都会拒绝不匹配的结果。我们提出利用正向反馈进行强化学习的逆合成方法 RetroRLFF，同时使用参考答案一致性和与目标产物的正向一致性来优化反应物生成。该方法从一个有监督的仅解码器 Transformer 开始，生成完整的候选反应物，并使用冻结的正向反应模型预测产物。序列级奖励结合参考答案一致性和正向一致性，同时惩罚无效输出。Direct Advantage-Based Policy Optimization 在不需要人工偏好标注或经过偏好训练的奖励模型的情况下更新策略。在 USPTO-50K 上，RetroRLFF 在 k = 1、3、5 和10的候选级往返准确率上均优于14个基线。它约有5,000万参数，在 top-1 往返准确率上达到90.1%，比该指标上最强的竞争基线 R-SMILES 高8.5个百分点。与其有监督策略相比，往返准确率从83.1%提升至90.1%，而精确匹配准确率保持在57.9%，对比57.5%。在对131个随机抽取测试案例进行的匿名专家评估中，有机合成专家在67.9%的比较中更偏好 RetroRLFF。专家评估为合成可行性提供了补充证据，但正向一致性和专家偏好都不能证明实验可行性。
items.author_line: Zixun Lan, Zhenfu Liu, Yi Li, Xinheng Wang, Mingmin Chi, Qibiao Wang, Jie Zhu, Xiaohui Tian, Fei Ma

items.title: RetroPlanner: Multi-Route Expansion and Multi-Objective Reasoning for LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-step retrosynthesis planning is often considered solved once a route to purchasable starting materials is found, but such a route should also be practical in real-world chemistry. Recent LLM-based planners formulate this process as sequential decision-making over an AND-OR graph, yet typically expand a single molecule per turn and are optimized for solvability alone, leaving alternative routes uncompared across the multiple objectives that determine practicality before the search budget is committed. We introduce RetroPlanner, an LLM-based planner that jointly compares multiple routes to steer the search toward higher synthesizability, as measured by reaction plausibility, round-trip consistency, and starting-material price. RetroPlanner is trained to reason over chemical evidence: structural progress from the target molecule, bond changes and reaction classes, where candidate routes diverge from one another, and how they rank across multiple objectives. Experiments on multi-step retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroPlanner recovers more alternative routes than prior LLM-based planners while improving synthetic route quality and maintaining a high success rate.
items.summary_zh: 提出 RetroPlanner，在 AND-OR 搜索中并行扩展并比较多条逆合成路线，联合考虑反应合理性、往返一致性和起始物价格，以提高路线实用性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把逆合成从“找到一条可行路线”推进到多目标路线选择，实验基准显示替代路线覆盖和路线质量均有提升；仍主要依赖基准数据和模型评价。
items.abstract_zh: 多步逆合成规划通常在找到一条通向可购买起始原料的路线后就被视为解决，但在现实化学中，这样的路线还应当实用。近期基于 LLM 的规划器将这一过程建模为 AND-OR 图上的序列决策，但通常每轮只扩展一个分子，并且只针对可解性进行优化，因此在搜索预算投入前不会比较决定实用性的多重目标。我们提出 RetroPlanner，这是一种基于 LLM 的规划器，可联合比较多条路线，引导搜索走向更高的可合成性，并以反应合理性、往返一致性和起始物价格进行衡量。RetroPlanner 被训练为围绕化学证据进行推理，包括目标分子的结构变化、键变化和反应类别、候选路线之间的分歧位置，以及它们在多目标上的排序。在多步逆合成基准上的实验表明，RetroPlanner 比先前的基于 LLM 的规划器找到了更多替代路线，同时提升了合成路线质量并保持较高的成功率。
items.author_line: Ye Rin Kim, Yongjun Jeong, Seongjun Yun, Hanbum Ko, Soohyun Oh, Sungbin Lim, Sungwoong Kim

items.title: MolHop: Scaffold-Hopping Molecular Design with Agentic Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. The agent selects new exploration regions through scaffold navigation actions and adjusts candidate properties through molecular editing. The framework maintains historical trajectory memory to support long-horizon search processes. On drug molecule and commercial compound tasks, connecting Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 to the MolHop framework substantially improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. We develop MolHop-9B through agentic reinforcement learning, and MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, while generating candidate molecules with larger scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that effective molecular discovery beyond the traditional optimization paradigm requires structured chemical and action spaces, enabling agents to explore new structural regions rather than merely refine existing molecules.
items.summary_zh: 提出 MolHop，将约160万个商业分子骨架组织成分层动作空间，通过骨架导航、分子编辑和轨迹记忆实现跨骨架分子发现，并训练 MolHop-9B 进行智能体强化学习。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对现有分子优化偏向局部微调的问题，显式扩大结构搜索范围，并报告跨骨架成功率和骨架差异提升；目前证据仍是计算比较，缺少实验命中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 分子设计通常被表述为在已有分子空间上进行优化。然而，分子优化与发现结构不同的替代分子是两个根本不同的搜索问题。基于 LLM 的分子设计智能体通常执行前一种任务，即在已有结构邻域内进行局部细化，通过结构修改改善目标性质。相比之下，后一种任务要求探索更广阔的化学空间，在保留参考分子功能特征的同时发现完全不同的骨架。我们提出 MolHop，这是一种用于跨骨架分子发现的智能体框架，使模型能够在预先组织的化学空间中导航和编辑。MolHop 将来自商业分子的约160万个分子骨架组织成由粗到细的分层动作空间。智能体通过骨架导航动作选择新的探索区域，并通过分子编辑调整候选性质。该框架维护历史轨迹记忆，以支持长期搜索过程。在药物分子和商业化合物任务上，将 Grok-4.6 和 DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 接入 MolHop 框架，显著提高了跨骨架联合成功率。我们通过智能体强化学习开发 MolHop-9B；与 GPT-5.6-sol、Claude-5-Opus 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro 等生成基线相比，MolHop-9B 表现更优，并生成与参考分子骨架差异更大的候选分子。这些结果表明，要突破传统优化范式开展有效分子发现，需要结构化的化学空间和动作空间，使智能体能够探索新的结构区域，而不只是细化已有结构。
items.author_line: Yanyi Su, Chenyan Wang, Yulei Gong, Yeyun Chen, Xiaohui Yang, Jun Cheng

items.title: PairIT: Autoregressive Transformers for Low-Data Molecule Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Generating novel molecules with desired properties is a central challenge in drug discovery. Although foundational work focused on de novo generation, practical use cases require a more complex setting: conditioning on an initial seed molecule, optimizing multiple properties, and operating in data-sparse regimes. We introduce PairIT, a flexible training framework for autoregressive transformers over SMILES sequences that enables seeded generation by learning from pairs of structurally similar molecules. By leveraging matched pairs, the model learns to generate local, chemically meaningful edits that improve a property of the seed molecule. Prompt tokens extend this framework by specifying the target property, desired direction, and approximate magnitude of change. Multiple prompt tokens can be concatenated to enable multi-property optimization at inference time. For properties where pair supervision alone is insufficient, reinforcement learning post-training can further improve optimization, providing a tunable trade-off between proximity to the seed and the optimization objective. PairIT naturally supports pretraining on a large dataset and fine-tuning on a smaller dataset, which is critical for performance in data-sparse regimes. Surprisingly, we observe diminishing returns to the scale of the pretraining dataset. We demonstrate empirically on MoleculeNet and Therapeutics Data Commons datasets that, with appropriate paired-data curation, a standard transformer model of modest size (68M parameters) can achieve robust seeded molecular optimization in low-data regimes.
items.summary_zh: 提出 PairIT，通过结构相似分子对训练自回归 SMILES Transformer，在低数据场景下进行种子分子、多性质约束的局部化学编辑，并可结合强化学习后训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 面向药物优化中常见的数据稀缺和多性质约束，68M 参数模型在 MoleculeNet 与 Therapeutics Data Commons 上表现稳健；结果依赖配对数据构造质量，且仍缺少实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 生成具有目标性质的新分子是药物发现中的核心挑战。尽管早期基础工作聚焦于从头生成，但实际应用需要更复杂的设置：以初始种子分子为条件、优化多个性质，并在数据稀疏的环境中运行。我们提出 PairIT，这是一种针对 SMILES 序列自回归 Transformer 的灵活训练框架，通过从结构相似分子对中学习来实现种子分子生成。利用匹配分子对，模型学习进行局部且具有化学意义的编辑，以改善种子分子的性质。提示 token 可指定目标性质、期望变化方向和变化幅度的大致值。在推理时可以串联多个提示 token，以实现多性质优化。对于仅靠分子对监督不足的性质，强化学习后训练可以进一步改善优化效果，并在接近种子分子和优化目标之间提供可调节的权衡。PairIT 天然支持在大数据集上预训练，再在较小数据集上微调，这对低数据场景下的性能至关重要。我们意外观察到，预训练数据集规模扩大带来的收益会逐渐递减。我们在 MoleculeNet 和 Therapeutics Data Commons 数据集上实证表明，在适当的配对数据整理下，一个规模适中的标准 Transformer 模型（6,800万参数）即可在低数据场景下实现稳健的种子分子优化。
items.author_line: Hannah Lawrence, Bodhi P. Vani, Ji Won Park, Natasa Tagasovska, Samuel Don Stanton, Andrew Martin Watkins, Michael Maser, Ewa M. Nowara

items.title: PMO-Dock: Benchmarking Docking, Specificity, and Generalization in Molecular Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: The Practical Molecular Optimization (PMO) benchmark standardized evaluation in molecular optimization, but it is built on simple property-based oracles that do not capture structure-based drug design. As the field has moved to docking-based objectives, evaluation practice has become unstandardized, and different methods report results on different docking tasks, often without a shared protocol for fair comparison or sample-efficiency constraints. To address this, we introduce Practical Molecular Optimization for Docking (PMO-Dock), a benchmark and protocol for docking-based optimization consisting of 25 tasks covering hit generation, lead optimization, and a new specificity task requiring strong on-target binding while penalizing off-target interactions. The protocol separates model development from final evaluation: validation tasks are used for hyperparameter tuning, and test tasks are held out for final evaluation and are not used during development. Evaluation on the test tasks is done under a strict oracle budget to reflect realistic drug-discovery settings. We benchmark four diverse high-performing methods spanning different optimization paradigms, Saturn (reinforcement learning), GenMol (discrete diffusion), Genetic-guided GFlowNet, and ChemLlama (LLM-based evolutionary search). Our results show no universally best method across tasks, additional analyses of hyperparameter transfer (cross-task and cross-category) and sensitivity show that transfer is often limited and varies by method, motivating method-dependent selection strategies. This benchmark provides a concrete standard for evaluating generalization to unseen tasks and sample efficiency under a limited test-time oracle budget.
items.summary_zh: 提出 PMO-Dock 基准与评测协议，覆盖25个基于对接的分子优化任务，包括命中生成、先导优化和兼顾 on-target/off-target 的特异性任务，并施加严格 oracle 预算。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为结构基础药物设计建立了统一、留出测试和样本效率约束的评测框架，显示不存在跨任务通用最优方法；其价值在于规范评估，而非提出新生成模型。
items.abstract_zh: Practical Molecular Optimization（PMO）基准统一了分子优化评估，但它建立在简单的基于性质的 oracle 上，无法体现结构基础药物设计。随着领域转向基于对接的目标，评估实践变得不统一，不同方法在不同对接任务上报告结果，往往没有共享协议来保证公平比较或样本效率约束。为此，我们提出 Practical Molecular Optimization for Docking（PMO-Dock），这是一个由25个任务组成的基准和协议，用于基于对接的优化，涵盖命中生成、先导优化，以及一个新的特异性任务，要求强的 on-target 结合并惩罚 off-target 相互作用。该协议将模型开发与最终评估分离：验证任务用于超参数调优，测试任务留作最终评估且在开发期间不可使用。测试任务在严格的 oracle 预算下评估，以反映现实的药物发现设置。我们对四种不同优化范式的高性能方法进行基准测试：强化学习方法 Saturn、离散扩散方法 GenMol、遗传引导的 GFlowNet 和基于 LLM 的进化搜索 ChemLlama。结果显示，没有一种方法在所有任务上都最优；超参数迁移分析（跨任务和跨类别）及敏感性分析表明，迁移能力通常有限且因方法而异，因此需要采用依赖方法的选择策略。该基准为评估未见任务上的泛化能力和有限测试时 oracle 预算下的样本效率提供了具体标准。
items.author_line: Gor Simonyan, Tatevik Abrahamyan, Narek Abelyan, Tigran Fahradyan, Hrant Khachatrian

items.title: Agentic-MatriBO: Capability-Compiled Agentic Bayesian Optimization for Materials and Chemical Design
items.abstract_or_text: Materials and chemical optimization must choose the next synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity simulation from sequential observations under a limited budget. Large language models can use task knowledge to propose adjustments, but composing surrogates, acquisition functions, and search strategies is constrained by compatibility, parameter dependencies, and evidence requirements. We present Agentic-MatriBO, a capability-compiled agentic Bayesian optimization (BO) framework that represents BO components and selection conditions as composable capabilities. A language policy proposes BO recipes and candidate plans; a compiler checks proposals against the registered capability catalog; and a deterministic execution layer validates and commits candidates. Oracle observations are stored in research memory and inform later rounds. We compare Agentic-MatriBO with eight baselines on four offline finite candidate pools---COF, PCE10, Buchwald--Hartwig (BH), and Suzuki--Miyaura---using five seeds per condition; results are reported descriptively. Across the four tasks, Agentic-MatriBO has the best mean endpoint quality after orienting each objective so that higher is better. On COF, it reaches the tabulated optimum in all five seeds both in the end-to-end comparison and after shared initialization, where it also retains an advantage in cumulative quality. Its normalized area under the best-so-far quality curve during the BO stage (nAUC-BO) is substantially higher on COF, near parity with the best baseline on PCE10 and BH, and lower on Suzuki. COF ablations show that removing the capability compiler or evidence gate coincides with lower cumulative quality and fewer exact-optimum hits. The framework provides an inspectable interface for evidence-conditioned BO adaptation.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Agentic-MatriBO，将贝叶斯优化组件表示为可组合能力，由语言策略提出方案、编译器检查兼容性、确定性执行层验证候选，并在 COF、PCE10、Buchwald--Hartwig 和 Suzuki--Miyaura 任务上比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把智能体提出的优化策略置于能力目录和证据门控之下，提高了过程可审计性；结果为离线有限候选池上的描述性比较，外推到真实实验仍需谨慎。
items.abstract_zh: 材料和化学优化必须在有限预算下，根据序贯观测选择下一次合成、表征或高保真模拟。大型语言模型可以利用任务知识提出调整方案，但代理模型、采集函数和搜索策略的组合受到兼容性、参数依赖和证据要求的约束。我们提出 Agentic-MatriBO，这是一种能力编译的智能体贝叶斯优化（BO）框架，将 BO 组件及其选择条件表示为可组合能力。语言策略提出 BO 配方和候选方案；编译器根据注册的能力目录检查这些提案；确定性执行层验证并提交候选。oracle 观测被存储在研究记忆中，并用于后续轮次。我们在四个离线有限候选池——COF、PCE10、Buchwald--Hartwig（BH）和 Suzuki--Miyaura——上与八个基线进行比较，每种条件使用五个随机种子；结果以描述性方式报告。在四项任务中，Agentic-MatriBO 在将每个目标定向为“越高越好”后，取得了最佳平均终点质量。在 COF 上，它在端到端比较以及共享初始化比较的全部五个随机种子中都达到表格给出的最优值；在共享初始化条件下，它在累积质量上也保持优势。在 BO 阶段，其最佳已见质量曲线归一化曲线下面积（nAUC-BO）在 COF 上显著更高，在 PCE10 和 BH 上接近最佳基线，在 Suzuki 上则更低。COF 消融实验显示，移除能力编译器或证据门控后，累积质量降低且达到精确最优值的次数减少。该框架提供了一个可检查的、以证据为条件的 BO 自适应接口。
items.author_line: Yu Zeng, Yuchuan Chen, Ziyue Zhang, Zijian Wei, Yanyi Su, Guojiang Zhao, Hongshuai Wang, Zhifeng Gao

items.title: DiffGA: Steering Frozen Diffusion Models for Materials Design via Evolutionary Search
items.abstract_or_text: Steering candidate generation toward user-defined objectives is central to inverse materials design, yet remains difficult when objectives are black-box, changing, or non-differentiable, as in many simulation- and experiment-derived properties. Generative models offer a solution but typically require retraining or fine-tuning for each new objective, demanding labeled data and substantial compute, or rely on differentiable guidance that is brittle to gradient noise and undefined for many practical targets. We present DiffGA, a retraining-free framework that injects evolutionary search into the sampling trajectory of a retrained diffusion model, evolving partially denoised states under an arbitrary black-box oracle. Because oracle evaluation often dominates campaign cost, we couple DiffGA with an on-the-fly Bayesian surrogate that reuses representations from state-of-the-art machine-learned force fields (MLFFs). A Gaussian process is fit during the campaign on the force fields's graph embeddings and, once it demonstrably ranks an unseen generation, replaces expensive property evaluations under an uncertainty-aware acquisition rule, reducing oracle cost with negligible loss of accuracy. Across three crystal-design tasks using a frozen MatterGen backbone, DiffGA outperforms diffusion-only, compute-matched, purely evolutionary, and fine-tuned baselines in oracle-assessed rates of stable, unique, and novel hits. Rather than proposing scientific compounds, we use density functional theory to quantify MLFF oracle fidelity, showing that it is a faithful proxy in key regimes but systematically biased in others, delineating when proxy-driven generative discovery can be trusted. On a representative sample, DiffGA's top hits survive first principles re-evaluation as physically realistic hits, while the surrogate-accelerated pipeline preserves this fidelity at a fraction of the cost.
items.summary_zh: 提出 DiffGA，在冻结的 MatterGen 扩散采样轨迹中引入进化搜索，并用基于机器学习力场表示的贝叶斯代理减少黑箱 oracle 评估成本；在三项晶体设计任务上进行验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 无需针对每个目标重新训练生成模型，并用 DFT 复核代理模型偏差与代表性命中，兼顾效率和物理可信度；适用范围仍受代理模型和任务设定限制。
items.abstract_zh: 将候选生成引向用户定义的目标是逆向材料设计的核心，但当目标是黑箱、不断变化或不可微时（例如许多来自模拟和实验的性质），这一任务仍然困难。生成模型提供了一种解决方案，但通常需要针对每个新目标重新训练或微调，这需要标注数据和大量计算；或者依赖可微引导，而后者对梯度噪声敏感，并且对许多实际目标并不存在。我们提出 DiffGA，这是一种无需重新训练的框架，将进化搜索注入经过训练的扩散模型的采样轨迹中，在任意黑箱 oracle 下演化部分去噪状态。由于 oracle 评估通常主导项目成本，我们结合在线贝叶斯代理，复用先进机器学习力场（MLFF）的表示。我们在项目过程中使用力场的图嵌入拟合高斯过程；一旦该模型能够可靠地对未见生成结果进行排序，就在不确定性感知采集规则下替代昂贵的性质评估，从而在准确率几乎不损失的情况下降低 oracle 成本。在三个晶体设计任务中，使用冻结的 MatterGen 主干，DiffGA 在 oracle 评估的稳定、唯一且新颖命中率上优于仅扩散、计算量匹配的纯进化以及微调基线。我们不直接提出科学化合物，而是使用密度泛函理论量化 MLFF oracle 的保真度，表明它在关键区域是可靠代理，但在其他区域存在系统偏差，从而界定了何时可以信任代理驱动的生成式发现。在代表性样本中，DiffGA 的 top 命中经第一性原理重新评估后仍是物理上合理的命中，而代理加速流程以更低成本保持了这一保真度。
items.author_line: Shivang Agarwal, Rodrigo Wang, Kevin Ryczko, Aayush R. Singh

items.title: ActMOF: Mapping Reticular Synthesis through Active Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Reticular chemistry allows metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) to be designed from their building units, yet their synthesis remains constrained by sparse experimental data, noisy crystallization outcomes, and the absence of benchmarks for comparing active-learning strategies. While data-driven approaches such as Bayesian optimization (BO) can improve synthesis success rates, selecting appropriate optimizers beforehand for mapping MOF crystallization landscapes remains largely empirical. Here we present ActMOF, an experiment-grounded benchmark for comparing search strategies in aluminum-carboxylate MOF synthesis. ActMOF is emulated from experimentally measured microwave syntheses with each encoded condition assigned a crystallinity index calculated based on diffraction peak intensity and full width at half-maximum. By benchmarking policies guided by Gaussian processes (GP), tree ensembles and large language models (LLM), ActMOF placed the GP family among the leading policies for active learning in sparse synthesis landscapes. It then demonstrated transferability by guiding the microwave synthesis of six reticularly related aluminum MOFs. All six campaigns gave crystalline products within a fixed budget of 12 experiments each, and established a reusable testbed for AI-driven MOF synthesis.
items.summary_zh: 提出 ActMOF，以实验测得的铝羧酸盐 MOF 微波合成数据构建主动学习基准，比较高斯过程、树模型和 LLM 策略，并在六个相关铝 MOF 合成活动中验证迁移性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把主动学习评估与真实晶化实验相连，六个项目均在每项12次实验预算内得到晶体产物；但基准来自特定 MOF 化学体系，泛化仍需更多体系检验。
items.abstract_zh: 网状化学允许根据构筑单元设计金属—有机框架（MOF），但其合成仍受实验数据稀疏、结晶结果噪声大以及缺乏主动学习策略比较基准的限制。尽管贝叶斯优化（BO）等数据驱动方法可以提高合成成功率，但在绘制 MOF 晶化景观之前选择合适的优化器仍主要依赖经验。我们提出 ActMOF，这是一个以实验为基础的基准，用于比较铝—羧酸盐 MOF 合成中的搜索策略。ActMOF 由实验测得的微波合成结果模拟而来，每个编码条件都被赋予一个根据衍射峰强度和半峰全宽计算的结晶度指数。通过对高斯过程（GP）、树集成模型和大型语言模型（LLM）引导的策略进行基准测试，ActMOF 将 GP 系列置于稀疏合成景观主动学习策略的领先位置。随后，它通过指导六种网状相关的铝 MOF 微波合成展示了可迁移性。六个项目均在每项固定12次实验预算内得到晶体产物，并建立了一个可复用的 AI 驱动 MOF 合成测试平台。
items.author_line: Hongrui Sheng, Shutian Liang, Reid A. Coyle, Shyam Chand Pal, Peter Walther, Bin Feng, Xinyu Ding, Zhiling Zheng

items.title: PROTEAN: Beyond De Novo Generation - Can LLM Agents Perform Text-Guided Protein Structure Editing?
items.abstract_or_text: Generative AI has achieved remarkable success in de novo protein design, yet protein engineering typically begins with existing, characterized proteins. The primary demand is targeted local editing, e.g., engineering a specific region to optimize affinity, alter immunogenicity, or improve stability, while strictly preserving core catalytic motifs and overall scaffold integrity. However, no standardized framework currently exists for carrying out and evaluating such edits. In current generative-design workflows, researchers often need to manually specify complex low-level parameters and rely on repetitive, trial-and-error sampling and evaluation across generative backends to search for viable conformations. While large language models (LLMs) offer an intuitive interface to express these goals using natural language, prevailing structure-generation models cannot directly interpret high-level human instructions. To bridge this gap, we introduce PROTEAN, a standardized benchmark for text-guided protein structural editing. PROTEAN comprises 380 sub-tasks spanning six intervention families and evaluates a two-stage pipeline in which an LLM translates natural-language goals into backend-specific geometric constraints and a generative model remodels the protein backbone. A two-tier evaluation separates geometric compliance, including target attainment and off-target scope fidelity, from biophysical realizability assessed by inverse folding and refolding consistency. Across five frontier LLMs paired with three backends, strict end-to-end biophysical success starts at just 7.0%. Ablation studies show that LLM constraint compilation is already highly accurate, whereas the main bottlenecks are backend-specific scope leakage and refolding failure. PROTEAN provides an open testbed for developing autonomous, multi-backend macromolecular design agents.
items.summary_zh: 提出 PROTEAN 文本引导蛋白结构编辑基准，覆盖380个子任务、六类干预和五个 LLM×三个生成后端组合，分别评估几何服从性与逆折叠/再折叠的生物物理可实现性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 明确区分语言约束编译、结构范围泄漏和再折叠失败等瓶颈，显示严格端到端生物物理成功率仅7.0%；作为基准平台很有价值，但不是新蛋白设计实验。
items.abstract_zh: 生成式 AI 在从头蛋白设计方面取得了显著成功，但蛋白工程通常从已有的、经过表征的蛋白质开始。实际主要需求是针对性局部编辑，例如优化亲和力、改变免疫原性或提高稳定性，同时严格保留核心催化基序和整体骨架完整性。然而，目前还没有用于执行和评估此类编辑的标准化框架。在现有生成式设计工作流中，研究人员通常需要手动指定复杂的低层参数，并依赖在不同生成后端之间反复采样和评估来寻找可行构象。大型语言模型（LLM）提供了用自然语言表达这些目标的直观接口，但现有结构生成模型不能直接理解高层次的人类指令。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 PROTEAN，一个文本引导蛋白结构编辑的标准化基准。PROTEAN 包含跨六类干预的380个子任务，并评估一个两阶段流程：LLM 将自然语言目标转换为特定后端的几何约束，生成模型据此重塑蛋白质骨架。两层评估将几何服从性（包括目标达成和非目标范围保真度）与生物物理可实现性（通过逆折叠和再折叠一致性评估）分开。在五个前沿 LLM 与三个后端的组合中，严格的端到端生物物理成功率起始值仅为7.0%。消融研究表明，LLM 约束编译已经相当准确，而主要瓶颈是后端特定的范围泄漏和再折叠失败。PROTEAN 为开发自主、多后端大分子设计智能体提供了开放测试平台。
items.author_line: Encheng Su, Xinping Liu, Yizhou Wang, Bozitao Zhong, Pengze Li, Jianyu Wu, Mingxiao Li, Xinzhu Ma, Aoran Wang, Liang Hong, Wanli Ouyang, Chen Tang, Houqiang Li, Shixiang Tang

items.title: Chemical foundation models reveal molecular principles underlying glycobiology
items.abstract_or_text: Glycans encode biological specificity through branching, linkage and stereochemical diversity, and have traditionally been modelled using specialised computational representations distinct from those developed for general chemistry. It remains unclear to what extent representations learned from general molecular chemistry capture the molecular principles of glycobiology. Here, we systematically evaluate the transfer of chemical foundation models to glycobiology using standardized benchmarks spanning taxonomy, immunogenicity, glycosylation type and protein-glycan interactions. We show that atom-level representations learned from general chemistry encode biologically meaningful molecular organization, providing particularly strong performance for molecular recognition, including immunogenicity and protein-glycan interaction prediction. Fine-tuning reorganizes these representations into latent spaces aligned with glycan architecture, glycosylation programmes and molecular recognition. Mechanistic analyses identify stereochemistry as an important determinant of successful transfer, while tokenization, context length and conformer generation influence the representation of large, branched glycans. These representations generalize from natural glycans to synthetic glycomimetics and recover experimentally validated stereochemistry-dependent glycan-lectin recognition. Together, our findings demonstrate that molecular principles learned from general chemistry are sufficient to capture fundamental features of glycobiology. They position glycans as a specialised region of chemical space and chemical foundation models as a broadly applicable framework for glycan function prediction, molecular recognition and glycomimetic discovery.
items.summary_zh: 系统评估化学基础模型向糖生物学的迁移，在糖分类、免疫原性、糖基化类型和蛋白质—聚糖相互作用任务上，发现通用化学表征可编码有意义的糖生物学规律。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将原子级化学表征与立体化学依赖的实验验证连接起来，并覆盖天然聚糖到糖模拟物的泛化；但模型性能受分词、上下文长度和构象生成影响。
items.abstract_zh: 聚糖通过分支、连接和立体化学多样性编码生物特异性，传统上一直使用不同于通用化学表示的专门计算表示进行建模。通用分子化学中学习到的表示在多大程度上能够捕捉糖生物学的分子原理，仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用涵盖分类、免疫原性、糖基化类型和蛋白质—聚糖相互作用的标准化基准，系统评估化学基础模型向糖生物学的迁移。我们表明，从通用化学中学习的原子级表示能够编码具有生物学意义的分子组织，尤其在分子识别任务（包括免疫原性和蛋白质—聚糖相互作用预测）上表现强劲。微调会将这些表示重新组织到与聚糖结构、糖基化程序和分子识别相一致的潜在空间中。机制分析指出，立体化学是成功迁移的重要决定因素，而分词、上下文长度和构象生成会影响大而分支聚糖的表示。这些表示能够从天然聚糖泛化到合成糖模拟物，并恢复经实验验证的、依赖立体化学的聚糖—凝集素识别。总之，我们的研究表明，从通用化学中学习的分子原理足以捕捉糖生物学的基本特征。这些结果将聚糖定位为化学空间中的一个专门区域，并将化学基础模型定位为预测聚糖功能、分子识别和发现糖模拟物的广泛适用框架。
items.author_line: Sokolov Ravasqueira, M., Bettencourt-Silva, J., Lopez Garcia, V., Fernandez-Diaz, R., Mulligan, N., Davey, G. P.

items.title: Affinity maturation of a single-domain antibody via rational mutagenesis informed by artificial intelligence
items.abstract_or_text: Antibodies can originate from various sources such as animal immunizations, patient material, DNA/RNA libraries and (AI-based) de novo design. Pre-made (e.g. synthetic) DNA libraries have substantial advantages over traditional immunization campaigns in terms of speed, cost, animal welfare, amount of required antigen and the possibility to select against otherwise problematic (e.g. toxic, unstable or expensive) antigens. The main downside is that selections from these non-immune libraries often result in binders with relatively low affinity due to the absence of in vivo affinity maturation. Now that in silico structure prediction tools are coming of age, the resulting models could conceivably be used to rationally design mutations, e.g. to enhance binding affinity. Here we used a synthetic single-domain antibody (sdAb) library to select new binders against interleukin-12 (IL-12). One of the selected candidates, 2F3, was predicted to bind to the p40 subunit of IL-12 in a manner that would compete with binding of the receptor protein IL-12R{beta}1. Intriguingly, this epitope is also targeted by the clinically approved antibodies Briakinumab and Ustekinumab, which are used to treat a variety of inflammation disorders. The predicted structure of the IL-12/sdAb complex was used to rationally design eleven point mutations, of which three showed to enhance the binding affinity. By combining these mutations, we could enhance the affinity by eightfold compared to the original lead clone. This shows that correctly (AI-)predicted protein structural models can be used for rational mutagenesis to enhance binding affinity to relevant drug targets.
items.summary_zh: 利用 AI 预测的 IL-12/sdAb 结构复合物指导11个定点突变，在合并突变后将单域抗体 2F3 对 IL-12 的亲和力提高8倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 有明确的理性突变和结合实验结果，展示结构预测用于抗体亲和力成熟的实际价值；但研究对象为单一抗体和靶点，结构预测误差及可迁移性仍需评估。
items.abstract_zh: 抗体可以来源于动物免疫、患者材料、DNA/RNA 文库以及（基于 AI 的）从头设计。与传统免疫流程相比，预制的（例如合成的）DNA 文库在速度、成本、动物福利、所需抗原量以及能够针对有毒、不稳定或昂贵抗原进行选择等方面具有显著优势。这些非免疫文库的主要缺点是，由于缺乏体内亲和力成熟，从中筛选得到的结合体通常亲和力较低。如今，随着计算机结构预测工具逐渐成熟，可以设想利用所得模型理性设计突变，例如增强结合亲和力。在本研究中，我们使用合成单域抗体（sdAb）文库筛选针对 interleukin-12（IL-12）的新结合体。其中一个筛选候选物 2F3 被预测为以能够与受体蛋白 IL-12R{beta}1 结合竞争的方式结合 IL-12 的 p40 亚基。有趣的是，这一表位也被临床批准的抗体 Briakinumab 和 Ustekinumab 靶向，它们用于治疗多种炎症性疾病。研究人员利用 IL-12/sdAb 复合物的预测结构理性设计了11个点突变，其中3个被证明能够提高结合亲和力。通过组合这些突变，亲和力相较于原始先导克隆提高了8倍。这表明，正确的（AI）预测蛋白质结构模型可用于理性突变，以提高对相关药物靶点的结合亲和力。
items.author_line: Tetteroo, S. L., Tawiah, C., Dekkers, G., Pronker, M. F.

items.title: PXRD-Bench: How Close Are We to Determining Crystal Structures from Powder Diffraction?
items.abstract_or_text: Determining crystal structures from powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) would enable routine characterization of newly synthesized materials, including those absent from reference databases. Generative models offer a promising approach, but existing evaluations remain fragmented and largely assume single-phase samples with known composition. To fill this gap, we introduce PXRD-Bench, a unified benchmark that extends evaluation to unknown per-element atom counts and recovery of both structures in two-phase mixtures. It provides approximately 4.1 million training structures with simulated PXRD, tests generalization to unseen compositions and structural prototypes, and evaluates recovery from experimental PXRD after excluding structurally matching training entries. To provide a strong reference baseline, we also introduce Bragglite, a PXRD-to-structure model developed through a systematic study of PXRD modeling choices. It achieves a 44.2\% Top-1 match rate on experimental RRUFF patterns with known composition, 24.6\% above the strongest prior baseline. Further analysis yields several key findings: some models fail to benefit from experimental PXRD, while generalization to unseen structural prototypes and recovery from two-phase mixtures remain challenging. Together, our benchmark, systematic studies, and Bragglite clarify the capabilities and limitations of current PXRD-to-structure models.
items.summary_zh: 提出 PXRD-Bench 和 Bragglite，评估从粉末 X 射线衍射恢复未知组成、未见结构原型及双相晶体结构的能力；在实验 RRUFF 图谱上取得44.2%的 Top-1 匹配率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 扩大了 PXRD 结构解析的现实评测范围并系统揭示未见原型和双相样品仍是瓶颈；结果依赖模拟训练数据和特定实验数据库。
items.abstract_zh: 从粉末 X 射线衍射（PXRD）确定晶体结构，将使对新合成材料进行常规表征成为可能，包括那些不在参考数据库中的材料。生成模型提供了一条有前景的途径，但现有评估较为零散，并且大多假设样品为单相且组成已知。为填补这一空白，我们提出 PXRD-Bench，将评估扩展到未知的逐元素原子数，以及双相混合物中两种结构的恢复。该基准提供约410万个带模拟 PXRD 的训练结构，测试对未见组成和结构原型的泛化能力，并在排除结构上匹配的训练条目后评估从实验 PXRD 中恢复结构的能力。作为有力的参考基线，我们还提出 Bragglite，并通过系统研究 PXRD 建模选择开发 PXRD-to-structure 模型。在已知组成的实验 RRUFF 图谱上，它达到44.2%的 Top-1 匹配率，比最强的先前基线高24.6%。进一步分析得到几个关键发现：一些模型无法从实验 PXRD 中获益，而对未见结构原型的泛化和双相混合物的恢复仍然具有挑战性。总体而言，我们的基准、系统研究和 Bragglite 阐明了当前 PXRD-to-structure 模型的能力与局限。
items.author_line: Dongyeop Woo, Nofit Segal, Nayoung Kim, Minkyu Kim, Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli, Sungsoo Ahn

items.title: Validation Design Governs the Apparent Predictive Performance of Machine Learning for PLGA Drug Release
items.abstract_or_text: Reliable generalization is essential for machine-learning models intended to predict drug-release behavior across heterogeneous experimental settings. However, multi-study experimental data often contain closely related formulations generated under shared materials, processing conditions, release protocols, and laboratory practices, creating hidden dependencies between training and test data. Such dependencies can make model performance appear stronger than its ability to generalize to genuinely new experimental domains. Here, we examine how validation topology governs the apparent predictability of poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) (PLGA) microparticle drug release using a public dataset containing 321 formulations and 4,913 release observations collected across 113 studies. Using a common LightGBM prediction framework, we compare validation schemes ranging from random observation splitting to strict study-grouped holdout. Predictive performance decreases markedly as train–test independence becomes more stringent, with 𝑅! declining from 0.939 under random point splitting to 0.616–0.625 under formulation-level holdout and 0.372 when entire studies are withheld. Controlled overlap experiments further show that retaining samestudy sibling formulations in the training set systematically increases apparent performance, while nearest-neighbor analysis reveals lower prediction error for formulations lying closer to the training distribution, particularly when their nearest training counterpart originates from the same study. These results show that formulation-level independence alone does not ensure experimental-domain independence and demonstrate that apparent drug-release predictability is strongly conditioned by validation design. Study-aware validation therefore provides a more rigorous basis for assessing generalization of machine-learning models trained on heterogeneous multi-study experimental data.
items.summary_zh: 使用包含321种配方、4,913条释放观测的 PLGA 微粒数据，比较从随机观测拆分到按研究分组留出的验证方式，显示严格的跨研究独立性会显著降低表观预测性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示药物释放模型中的隐藏数据依赖和验证拓扑偏差，为跨实验室泛化提供更严格的评估建议；研究仍是预印本，且只涉及 PLGA 释放体系。
items.abstract_zh: 对于旨在预测异质实验条件下药物释放的机器学习模型而言，可靠的泛化能力至关重要。然而，多研究实验数据往往包含由共享材料、加工条件、释放方案和实验室实践产生的密切相关配方，使训练集和测试集之间存在隐藏依赖。这些依赖会使模型性能看起来强于其在真正新实验领域中的泛化能力。在这里，我们使用包含321种配方和来自113项研究的4,913条释放观测的公开数据集，研究验证拓扑如何影响聚乳酸-羟基乙酸共聚物（PLGA）微粒药物释放的表观可预测性。使用共同的 LightGBM 预测框架，我们比较了从随机观测拆分到严格按研究分组留出的多种验证方案。随着训练集与测试集独立性要求提高，预测性能显著下降：在随机点拆分下，R²从0.939下降到配方级留出时的0.616-0.625，并在整个研究被留出时降至0.372。受控重叠实验进一步表明，在训练集中保留同一研究的姊妹配方，会系统性提高表观性能；最近邻分析显示，与训练分布更接近的配方预测误差更低，尤其当其最近训练邻居来自同一研究时。这些结果表明，仅保证配方级独立并不能确保实验领域独立，并证明在异质多研究数据上训练的机器学习模型，其表观药物释放可预测性强烈受验证设计影响。因此，采用以研究为单位的验证，是评估此类模型泛化能力更严格的基础。
items.author_line: Tengxiao Liu, Juchen Zhang, Hongtao Sun

items.title: Beyond Benchmark Accuracy: A Diagnostic Test for LLM Chemical Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: LLMs have achieved strong performance on chemical prediction benchmarks. However, existing evaluation methods typically provide target entity identity information directly, making it difficult to determine whether model predictions arise from transferable structure-property reasoning capabilities or rely on target-related contextual information or memory retrieval. We propose the Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic framework to evaluate chemical prediction models when target entity identity information is hidden. In this framework, the target is no longer directly defined by its entity identity, but instead by a known source entity and an explicit structural edit operation. This setting preserves the information required to determine the target while reducing the opportunity for models to access target identity cues. We evaluate this framework across six tasks spanning odor prediction, molecular property prediction, retrosynthesis, and reaction yield prediction. The results show that models generally achieve better prediction performance when source and target entity properties are consistent. Providing explicit source entity labels further strengthens this dependence. Moreover, while keeping the target entity, structural change, and ground-truth label unchanged, replacing only the source entity label causes some model predictions to systematically shift toward the substituted source labels. These results indicate that high benchmark accuracy in chemical prediction tasks does not necessarily imply that LLMs possess reliable structure-property reasoning capabilities. Our diagnostic framework provides a controlled evaluation approach for testing whether models can genuinely update predictions according to entity changes. The framework can be extended to other AI for Science tasks, particularly those where targets can be defined through transformations of known entities.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic，在隐藏目标实体身份、仅提供来源实体与结构编辑操作的条件下，评估 LLM 在气味、分子性质、逆合成和反应收率预测中的真正结构—性质推理能力。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示高基准准确率可能依赖实体记忆或上下文线索，而非可迁移的结构推理，为化学模型评测提供了可控诊断框架；尚未覆盖更广泛的模型和实验任务。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在化学预测基准上取得了很高的性能。然而，现有评估方法通常直接提供目标实体的身份信息，因此难以判断模型预测究竟来自可迁移的结构—性质推理能力，还是依赖目标相关的上下文信息或记忆检索。我们提出 Identity-Blinded Reasoning Diagnostic 框架，在隐藏目标实体身份的条件下评估化学预测模型。在该框架中，目标不再由实体身份直接定义，而是由一个已知的来源实体和一个明确的结构编辑操作定义。这种设置保留了确定目标所需的信息，同时减少模型获取目标身份线索的机会。我们在涵盖气味预测、分子性质预测、逆合成和反应收率预测的六项任务上评估该框架。结果显示，当来源实体和目标实体的性质一致时，模型通常取得更好的预测性能。提供明确的来源实体标签会进一步加强这种依赖。此外，在保持目标实体、结构变化和真实标签不变的情况下，仅替换来源实体标签，就会使一些模型的预测系统性地向被替换的来源标签偏移。这些结果表明，化学预测任务中的高基准准确率并不一定意味着 LLM 具备可靠的结构—性质推理能力。我们的诊断框架提供了一种受控的评估方法，用于检验模型是否能够根据实体变化真正更新预测。该框架还可扩展到其他 AI for Science 任务，尤其是目标可以通过已知实体变换来定义的任务。
items.author_line: Yanyi Su, Yu Zeng, Hongshuai Wang, Chenyan Wang, Zhifeng Gao, Xiaohui Yang

items.title: Multimodal Machine Learning-Based Clinical and Genomic Prognostic Factors for Progression-Free Survival in Metastatic Breast Cancer Using Phase III MONALEESA Trials
items.abstract_or_text: Purpose: Cyclin-dependent kinase 4/6 inhibitors in combination with endocrine therapy have become widely adopted as a first-line treatment approach for hormone receptor-positive (HR+)/human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-negative (HER2-) advanced breast cancer (ABC). Through a collaboration between Novartis and the US Food and Drug Administration, we integrated multimodal data from phase III MONALEESA trials to identify novel prognostic factors for HR+/HER2- ABC. Experimental Design: Baseline clinical and genomics data were collected from patients in the MONALEESA-2, -3, and -7 trials. Circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) from plasma samples and gene expression in archival tumor biopsies were analyzed. Machine learning models were trained (n = 1,355) on progression-free survival (PFS) using multimodal features via fusion models. In a test set (n = 382), prognostic performances were evaluated using the Kaplan-Meier, Cox, and Weibull models. Results: The late fusion model achieved a prognostic performance (C-index: 0.727, 95% CI: 0.641-0.799) slightly outperforming early fusion (C-index: 0.718, 95% CI: 0.631-0.791) and single-modality models. Model-based risk stratification identified distinct low- and high-risk groups (PFS HR, 0.28; 95% CI: 0.20-0.38). Among the top 40 features for progression risk (18 clinical, 20 gene expression, and 2 ctDNA), these were associated with higher risk: liver involvement, higher histological grades, early relapse; lower STC2 and RBBP8 expressions and higher FBX05 expression; and higher tumor mutational burden and ctDNA purity. Conclusions: Integrating clinical and genomic modalities improved progression risk prediction compared with single-modality models, while highlighting salient features that inform the underlying biology and support hypothesis generation.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；clinical】整合 MONALEESA-2、-3、-7 三项 III 期试验的临床、基因表达和 ctDNA 数据，利用多模态融合模型预测 HR+/HER2− 晚期乳腺癌无进展生存期。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 训练集 1,355 例、测试集 382 例，后期融合模型的 C-index 略优于早期融合和单模态模型；结果可用于风险分层和提出生物学假设，但特征关联不代表因果。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶 4/6 抑制剂与内分泌治疗联用，已广泛作为激素受体阳性（HR+）/人表皮生长因子受体 2 阴性（HER2−）晚期乳腺癌（ABC）的一线治疗。诺华与美国食品药品监督管理局合作，整合 III 期 MONALEESA 试验的多模态数据，以识别 HR+/HER2− ABC 的新型预后因素。实验设计：收集 MONALEESA-2、-3 和 -7 试验患者的基线临床及基因组数据。分析血浆循环肿瘤 DNA（ctDNA）和存档肿瘤活检样本中的基因表达。使用多模态特征的融合模型，在 n = 1,355 的数据上训练无进展生存期（PFS）模型。在 n = 382 的测试集中，使用 Kaplan-Meier、Cox 和 Weibull 模型评估预后性能。结果：后期融合模型的预后性能（C-index：0.727，95% CI：0.641-0.799）略优于早期融合模型（C-index：0.718，95% CI：0.631-0.791）和单模态模型。基于模型的风险分层识别出不同的低风险组和高风险组（PFS HR，0.28；95% CI：0.20-0.38）。进展风险排名前 40 的特征中包括 18 个临床特征、20 个基因表达特征和 2 个 ctDNA 特征；与更高风险相关的因素包括肝脏受累、较高组织学分级、早期复发、较低的 STC2 和 RBBP8 表达、较高的 FBX05 表达，以及较高的肿瘤突变负荷和 ctDNA 纯度。结论：与单一模态模型相比，整合临床和基因组模态提高了进展风险预测能力，同时突出了可提示潜在生物学并支持假设生成的重要特征。

items.title: Cerebral microthrombi promote focal Cav-1-dependent blood-brain barrier impairment, triggering neuroinflammation and neuronal damage after traumatic brain injury
items.abstract_or_text: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is frequently accompanied by blood-brain barrier (BBB) dysfunction, yet the microvascular events that initiate barrier failure and secondary neural injury remain poorly understood. Using highly sensitive fluorescent nanoscale tracers, correlative light and electron microscopy, single-cell transcriptomics, and genetic manipulation of Caveolin-1 (Cav-1), we show that BBB leakage after TBI in mice occurs focally at sites of cerebral microthrombus formation. Endothelial cells adjacent to microthrombi remain structurally intact, but exhibit a distinct transcriptional program enriched in both thrombosis- and transcytosis-related genes, including Cav-1. Microthrombi promote Cav-1-dependent transcytosis and size-selective extravasation of blood-borne proteins, exposing the surrounding parenchyma to circulating factors and inducing focal microglia activation and neuronal damage in vivo. In human induced pluripotent stem cell-derived neurons, these proteins directly impaired neuronal structure and network function. Genetic deletion of Cav-1 markedly reduces microthrombus-associated BBB leakage, immune-cell diapedesis, microglial activation and neuronal loss, whereas endothelial re-expression of Cav-1 using AAVs restores leakage. Human TBI data reveal early dynamic coagulation dysregulation associated with adverse clinical outcome, focal cerebral vascular injury and endothelial transcriptional signatures consistent with reduced barrier integrity and increased caveolae-associated transport. Together, these findings identify cerebral microthrombi as focal sites of Cav-1-dependent BBB dysfunction and establish pathological endothelial transcytosis as a mechanistic link between post-traumatic microvascular thrombosis, blood protein extravasation and secondary neuronal injury. Targeting Cav-1-dependent transcytosis may therefore provide a strategy to limit pathological BBB permeability and secondary injury after TBI.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；in vivo】结合荧光纳米示踪、光电关联成像、单细胞转录组和 Cav-1 遗传操作，研究创伤性脑损伤后微血栓、血脑屏障渗漏与神经损伤的联系。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 小鼠、人体数据和人源 iPSC 神经元实验共同支持 Cav-1 依赖性内皮跨胞转运这一机制链；Cav-1 靶向仍需进一步验证其治疗价值。
items.abstract_zh: 创伤性脑损伤（TBI）常伴随血脑屏障（BBB）功能障碍，但引发屏障失效和继发性神经损伤的微血管事件仍缺乏充分认识。利用高灵敏度荧光纳米尺度示踪剂、光学与电子显微镜关联成像、单细胞转录组学以及 Caveolin-1（Cav-1）遗传操作，我们显示，小鼠 TBI 后的 BBB 渗漏在脑微血栓形成部位呈局灶性发生。邻近微血栓的内皮细胞在结构上仍保持完整，但表现出一种独特的转录程序，其中富集血栓形成和跨胞转运相关基因，包括 Cav-1。微血栓促进 Cav-1 依赖的跨胞转运以及血源性蛋白的尺寸选择性外渗，使周围脑实质暴露于循环因子，并在体内诱导局灶性小胶质细胞激活和神经元损伤。在人诱导多能干细胞来源的神经元中，这些蛋白直接损害神经元结构和网络功能。Cav-1 基因敲除显著减少微血栓相关的 BBB 渗漏、免疫细胞穿越内皮、小胶质细胞激活和神经元丢失；而使用 AAV 使内皮细胞重新表达 Cav-1 则恢复渗漏。人类 TBI 数据显示，早期动态凝血失调与不良临床结局、局灶性脑血管损伤以及提示屏障完整性下降和小窝相关转运增加的内皮转录特征相关。综上，这些结果将脑微血栓确定为 Cav-1 依赖性 BBB 功能障碍的局灶部位，并建立了病理性内皮跨胞转运在创伤后微血管血栓形成、血液蛋白外渗和继发性神经元损伤之间的机制联系。因此，靶向 Cav-1 依赖的跨胞转运可能成为限制病理性 BBB 通透性和继发性损伤的一种策略。

items.title: Decoding super-enhancer regulatory grammar and pathogenic gain-of-function variants directly from DNA sequence
items.abstract_or_text: Super-enhancers (SEs) drive cell-identity gene expression, yet their identification relies on epigenomic profiling (e.g., H3K27ac ChIP-seq), precluding discovery in unprofiled cellular states and leaving their underlying sequence grammar unknown. Here, we present Borzoi-SE, a deep learning framework built upon the genomic transformer Borzoi that formulates SE discovery as hierarchical, cell-type-resolved genomic object detection directly from long-range sequence across 90 human lineages. Base-resolution attribution recovers lineage-defining master transcription factors across cell types. Within SEs shared across lineages, it reveals lineage-dependent motif usage, suggesting that the same regulatory regions can support distinct cell-type-specific programs. Using in silico ablation, Borzoi-SE decoded the functional hierarchy of the {beta}-globin super-enhancer, prioritizing hypersensitive site 2 (HS2) as the dominant constituent, which we experimentally verified via CRISPR interference. Trained without variant-effect labels, Borzoi-SE identified gain-of-super-enhancer variants in different tissues. At the CHRM2 locus, a single-nucleotide variant created a de novo glucocorticoid receptor (GR) motif that recruited activated GR and potentiated adjacent MEF2 regulatory syntax, nucleating a cardiac super-enhancer. Orthogonal multi-omics and population-genetic evidence linked this variant to increased CHRM2 expression and variation in resting heart rate and PR-interval duration. Borzoi-SE establishes a general framework for decoding SE regulatory grammar and prioritizing causal non-coding variants directly from sequence.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；实验】Borzoi-SE 从长程 DNA 序列直接识别 90 种人类谱系的超级增强子，解析其调控语法，并用 CRISPRi 验证 β-珠蛋白超级增强子中的关键位点。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型结合碱基分辨率归因、计算消融、多组学和实验验证，能够提出非编码变异的功能机制；对 CHRM2 位点的解释仍应视为机制证据而非完整因果证明。
items.abstract_zh: 超级增强子（SE）驱动细胞身份基因的表达，但其识别依赖表观基因组分析（例如 H3K27ac ChIP-seq），因此无法在缺乏相应谱系数据的细胞状态中发现超级增强子，其底层序列语法也仍不清楚。在这里，我们提出 Borzoi-SE，这是一种建立在基因组 Transformer 模型 Borzoi 之上的深度学习框架，将超级增强子发现表述为直接依据长程序列、且具有层级和细胞类型分辨率的基因组对象检测任务。碱基分辨率归因在不同细胞类型中恢复了定义谱系的主调控转录因子。在多个谱系共享的超级增强子中，模型揭示了依赖谱系的基序使用方式，提示同一调控区域可以支持不同的细胞类型特异性程序。通过计算消融，Borzoi-SE 解码了 β-珠蛋白超级增强子的功能层级，将超敏感位点 2（HS2）优先确定为主要组成部分，并通过 CRISPR 干扰实验进行了验证。在没有使用变异效应标签训练的情况下，Borzoi-SE 识别出不同组织中的超级增强子获得性变异。在 CHRM2 位点，一个单核苷酸变异产生了新的糖皮质激素受体（GR）基序，招募了活化的 GR 并增强邻近的 MEF2 调控语法，从而启动一个心脏超级增强子。正交多组学和群体遗传学证据将该变异与 CHRM2 表达升高以及静息心率和 PR 间期时长的变异联系起来。Borzoi-SE 建立了一个通用框架，可直接从序列解码超级增强子调控语法并优先筛选具有潜在因果作用的非编码变异。

items.title: Joint Variable Selection for Omic Biomarkers in Time-to-Event Data
items.abstract_or_text: The incidence of the vast majority of neurodegenerative, cancer, and metabolic diseases generally increases exponentially with age. In large-scale biobanks, linking time-to-diagnosis information in electronic health records to multiple genomic (``multiomics'') measures has the potential to reveal the genes and biological pathways involved in the disease onset and progression. To date, association testing has commonly been conducted by testing one variable at a time using semiparametric Cox proportional hazards (CoxPH) models, which ignores correlation structure and increases the risk of false discoveries. To address these issues, we introduce a novel fully parametric Bayesian computational method, vampW, based on the Vector Approximate Message Passing framework applied to a Weibull model. vampW jointly models correlated features, while providing an interpretable hazard structure, producing a continuous survival curve, and incorporating prior knowledge. In an extensive simulation study, we demonstrate that joint modeling of omics data and time-to-event outcomes with vampW, substantially reduces false discoveries in comparison to marginal testing and other forms of joint CoxPH models. In 53,018 individuals from the UK Biobank, vampW identifies 219 protein associations with 24 disease outcomes, most of which are not among the top marginal discoveries. We further correct protein levels for exponential age effects, identifying 1,308 associations and highlighting the sensitivity of the analysis to age-correction methodology. Our findings replicate in independent cohorts using different measurement technologies, within data from Iceland and a novel Generation Scotland proteomics dataset. vampW also achieves significant improvement in the prediction of disease onset times: across 14 outcomes, it reduces the root mean squared error by over 30% and 26%, when compared to CoxPH variants and the deep learning approach DeepSurv, respectively, while maintaining predictive utility in minority populations. In summary, vampW offers accurate and interpretable variable selection and out-of-sample prediction within a single computational framework, making it a powerful tool for dissecting the genomic architecture of common complex disease onset.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；大规模组学】vampW 是基于向量近似消息传递和 Weibull 模型的贝叶斯方法，可联合选择相关组学特征并建模疾病发生时间。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 UK Biobank 53,018 人中识别蛋白—疾病关联，并在独立队列和不同测量技术中复现；同时降低假发现并改善发生时间预测，具有较强可复现性。
items.abstract_zh: 绝大多数神经退行性疾病、癌症和代谢性疾病的发生率通常会随年龄呈指数增长。在大型生物样本库中，将电子健康记录中的确诊时间信息与多种基因组（“多组学”）测量联系起来，有望揭示参与疾病发生和进展的基因及生物学通路。迄今为止，关联检验通常使用半参数 Cox 比例风险（CoxPH）模型一次检验一个变量，这会忽略相关结构并增加假发现风险。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种新的全参数贝叶斯计算方法 vampW：将向量近似消息传递框架应用于 Weibull 模型。vampW 联合建模相关特征，同时提供可解释的风险结构，生成连续生存曲线，并纳入先验知识。在广泛的模拟研究中，我们显示，与边际检验和其他形式的联合 CoxPH 模型相比，联合建模组学数据与事件发生时间结局的 vampW 能大幅减少假发现。在 UK Biobank 的 53,018 名个体中，vampW 识别出与 24 种疾病结局相关的 219 个蛋白关联，其中大多数不属于边际发现排名靠前的关联。我们进一步针对蛋白水平的年龄指数效应进行校正，识别出 1,308 个关联，并突出显示分析对年龄校正方法的敏感性。我们的发现使用不同测量技术在独立队列中得到复现，包括冰岛数据和一个新的 Generation Scotland 蛋白质组数据集。与 CoxPH 变体和深度学习方法 DeepSurv 相比，vampW 还显著改善疾病发生时间的预测：在 14 个结局中，均方根误差分别降低超过 30% 和 26%，同时保持了在少数群体中的预测效用。总之，vampW 在单一计算框架中提供了准确且可解释的变量选择和样本外预测，是解析常见复杂疾病发生遗传架构的有力工具。

items.title: Prediction of incident inflammatory bowel disease from routine electronic health records: development and external validation of a longitudinal machine learning model
items.abstract_or_text: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is often diagnosed months to years after symptoms begin, and diagnostic delay is associated with complications. We tested whether longitudinal machine learning using electronic health record (EHR) data can identify incident IBD before diagnosis, and quantified lead time and deployment burden. METHODS: We studied adults with an IBD-compatible symptom, sign, or finding at UCSF (2012-2024). Incident cases were confirmed by structured filtering and validated large language model note review. We trained a state space model (Mamba) and comparators on pre-diagnostic EHR data, excluding diagnostic-workup features, and assessed discrimination at 6- and 12-month landmarks. We externally tested Mamba without recalibration at ZSFG, a safety-net hospital serving a demographically and socioeconomically distinct population, and simulated diagnosis-code-only deployment at UCSF. RESULTS: Six months after presentation, among patients still undiagnosed (67% of UCSF test cases), Mamba achieved an AUROC of 0.969 (95% CI, 0.928-0.999) at UCSF and 0.965 (0.952-0.976) at ZSFG. Median lead time was 20 months at UCSF and 15 months at ZSFG. Among future cases with an initially normal colonoscopy (N=32) or a histological finding of acute inflammation without chronicity (N=63), the model flagged 84% and 89% of these patients, respectively, before those procedures, indicating the potential for pre-diagnostic detection. Among 358,886 symptomatic patients not used for training (60 incident cases), the diagnosis-code-only model achieved an AUROC of 0.926; reviewing 20 alerts/month identified 34 cases (PPV, 1.09%; 64-fold above baseline). CONCLUSIONS: Longitudinal machine learning can identify increased IBD risk months to years before diagnosis and may define a population for prospective studies of early IBD biology. Prospective evaluation should determine whether earlier identification reduces diagnostic delay.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；clinical】基于纵向 EHR 的 Mamba 模型在 UCSF 和 ZSFG 外部验证中，可在 IBD 正式诊断前中位提前 20 和 15 个月识别风险。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在不同人群和医院进行无再校准外部测试，并评估部署负担；结果支持前瞻性研究，但尚未证明提前识别能减少诊断延迟。
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目的：炎症性肠病（IBD）通常在症状开始数月至数年后才被诊断，诊断延迟与并发症相关。我们检验了使用电子健康记录（EHR）数据进行纵向机器学习是否能够在诊断前识别新发 IBD，并量化提前时间和部署负担。方法：我们研究了 UCSF（2012-2024 年）具有与 IBD 相符的症状、体征或检查结果的成年人。通过结构化筛选确认新发病例，并由经过验证的大型语言模型进行病历复核。我们在诊断前 EHR 数据上训练状态空间模型（Mamba）及比较模型，排除诊断性检查相关特征，并在 6 个月和 12 个月时间节点评估区分能力。在服务人群在人口学和社会经济方面不同的安全网医院 ZSFG，我们无需再校准就对 Mamba 进行外部测试，并在 UCSF 模拟仅使用诊断代码的部署。结果：在就诊后 6 个月、仍未确诊的患者中（占 UCSF 测试病例的 67%），Mamba 在 UCSF 的 AUROC 为 0.969（95% CI，0.928-0.999），在 ZSFG 为 0.965（0.952-0.976）。UCSF 和 ZSFG 的中位提前时间分别为 20 个月和 15 个月。在未来病例中，对于最初结肠镜检查正常者（N=32）或组织学显示急性炎症但无慢性改变者（N=63），模型在这些检查之前分别标记出 84% 和 89% 的患者，提示其具有诊断前检测潜力。在未用于训练的 358,886 名有症状患者中（其中 60 例新发病例），仅使用诊断代码的模型 AUROC 为 0.926；每月复核 20 个警报可识别 34 例病例（PPV，1.09%；为基线的 64 倍）。结论：纵向机器学习能够在诊断前数月至数年识别升高的 IBD 风险，并可能界定一个用于研究 IBD 早期生物学的群体。前瞻性评估应确定更早识别是否能够减少诊断延迟。

items.title: A Single-Cell Atlas of PVOD Across the Lifespan Reveals Cellular and Molecular Therapeutic Targets
items.abstract_or_text: Rationale Pulmonary veno-occlusive disease (PVOD) is a progressive and lethal disease cured only lung transplant. While genetic mutations in EIF2AK4 have been identified in some cases, 70% of PVOD patients have no known etiology. Objectives To construct a single-cell atlas to define the cellular and molecular constituents driving pathophysiology in PVOD. Methods Lung samples were collected from four idiopathic non-EIF2AK4 mutation pediatric and adult PVOD patients and age-matched controls. Analyses of single-cell RNA sequencing, Xenium spatial transcriptomics, and immunohistochemistry were performed to identify cell state changes and differential gene expression between controls and PVOD and subsequent transcriptome comparison between our PVOD and published pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) datasets. Measurement and Main Results The single-cell atlas reveals marked changes in the PVOD endothelium compared to controls. EndMT and ectopic COL15A1+ systemic venous shunts and pulmonary vein endothelium are hallmarks of PVOD. Molecular analyses reveal activation of the integrated stress response (ISR)/ATF4, TGF{beta} signaling, MAPK signaling, and BRD4 are potential key players in the pathophysiology of PVOD. While PVOD and PAH share both pathological and some molecular mechanisms, ISR and TGF{beta} signaling are more prominent in PVOD than PAH. Conclusions These data indicate that endothelial dysfunction is a primary etiology in the development of PVOD with activation of multiple pathways with druggable targets.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】基于单细胞 RNA 测序、Xenium 空间转录组和免疫组化构建 PVOD 全生命周期图谱，识别内皮细胞状态变化及潜在可药物化通路。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖儿童和成人特发性 PVOD，并与 PAH 数据比较；样本量有限且为观察性图谱，治疗靶点仍需功能验证。
items.abstract_zh: 依据：肺静脉闭塞性疾病（PVOD）是一种进行性且致命的疾病，唯一治愈方法是肺移植。虽然部分病例中已发现 EIF2AK4 基因突变，但 70% 的 PVOD 患者仍无已知病因。目的：构建单细胞图谱，以界定驱动 PVOD 病理生理的细胞和分子组成。方法：收集 4 例无 EIF2AK4 突变的特发性 PVOD 儿童和成人患者的肺样本，以及年龄匹配的对照样本。开展单细胞 RNA 测序、Xenium 空间转录组和免疫组化分析，识别对照组与 PVOD 之间的细胞状态变化和差异基因表达，并进一步将本研究的 PVOD 转录组与已发表的肺动脉高压（PAH）数据集进行比较。测量结果与主要结果：单细胞图谱显示，PVOD 内皮与对照相比发生显著变化。内皮-间质转化（EndMT）、异位 COL15A1+ 体静脉分流以及肺静脉内皮是 PVOD 的标志。分子分析显示，整合应激反应（ISR）/ATF4、TGFβ 信号、MAPK 信号和 BRD4 可能是病理生理中的关键参与者。虽然 PVOD 和 PAH 共享一些病理及分子机制，但 ISR 和 TGFβ 信号在 PVOD 中更为突出。结论：这些数据表明，内皮功能障碍是 PVOD 发生的主要病因，并伴随多条具有药物靶向潜力的通路被激活。

items.title: Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Fusion Models to Predict Response to Venetoclax and Azacitidine in Patients with Newly Diagnosed Acute Myeloid Leukemia
items.abstract_or_text: Venetoclax and azacitidine (ven-aza) is a standard of care therapy for newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia (AML) patients unfit to receive intensive therapy, and may also be appropriate for certain fit patients. Models predicting response to ven-aza currently focus predominantly on genetics. Here, we present two multimodal fusion models: a custom ResNet-34-based model and a pathology foundation model fine-tuned for bone marrow smear (BMS) images that combine clinical and genetic variables with whole slide images. Training on 193 newly diagnosed AML patients who received ven-aza, we obtained an area-under-the-receiver-operating-characteristic (AUROC) of 0.79 and 0.82 for the ResNet-based and fine-tuned foundation models in a heldout test set, and 0.76 and 0.73 in an external validation set, predicting best response to this therapy. Sensitivity analysis showed that fusing image data with clinical and genetic variables outperformed training on either modality alone. In univariable and multivariable analyses, image-based classification was an independent predictive marker, second only in effect size to IDH1/2 mutation status, outperforming other genetic alterations. Image-based explainability showed high model attention on myeloblasts, suggesting previously unrecognized cell-specific patterns associated with response. Our findings suggest BMS images complement genetic biomarkers to refine outcome prediction in ven-aza treatment and incentivize AI-supported outcome prediction, including bone marrow morphology.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；clinical】将骨髓涂片图像与临床和遗传变量融合，预测新诊断 AML 患者对 venetoclax/azacitidine 的反应；外部验证 AUROC 为 0.73-0.76。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 193 例训练队列同时包含保留测试集和外部验证，提示形态学图像可补充遗传标志物；仍需更大规模前瞻性验证。
items.abstract_zh: Venetoclax 和 azacitidine（ven-aza）是无法接受强化治疗的新诊断急性髓系白血病（AML）患者的标准治疗，也可能适用于某些适合强化治疗的患者。目前预测 ven-aza 反应的模型主要聚焦于遗传学。在这里，我们提出两个多模态融合模型：一个定制的基于 ResNet-34 的模型，以及一个针对骨髓涂片（BMS）图像微调的病理学基础模型；两者均将临床和遗传变量与全玻片图像结合。在接受 ven-aza 治疗的 193 例新诊断 AML 患者上训练后，基于 ResNet 的模型和微调基础模型在留出测试集上预测最佳治疗反应的 AUROC 分别为 0.79 和 0.82，在外部验证集上分别为 0.76 和 0.73。敏感性分析显示，将图像数据与临床和遗传变量融合，优于仅使用任一单一模态进行训练。在单变量和多变量分析中，基于图像的分类是独立预测标志物，其效应量仅次于 IDH1/2 突变状态，并优于其他遗传改变。基于图像的可解释性分析显示，模型高度关注原始髓母细胞，提示与反应相关的、此前未被认识的细胞特异性模式。我们的发现提示，BMS 图像可以补充遗传生物标志物，以改进 ven-aza 治疗结局预测，并推动包括骨髓形态学在内的 AI 辅助结局预测。

items.title: Deep Learning and Radiomics Models for Predicting 90-Day Outcomes in Ischemic Stroke: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Background Accurate prediction of 90-day outcomes following ischemic stroke is crucial for optimizing clinical strategies. This study aimed to systematically review and meta-analyze studies using deep learning (DL) and hand-crafted radiomics (HCR) models for predicting 90-day modified Rankin Scale (mRS) outcomes after ischemic stroke. Methods We followed the PRISMA guidelines for systematic reviews. Four databases (PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library) were searched comprehensively for studies published up to September 2025. Inclusion criteria encompassed original research focusing on ischemic stroke patients with mRS at 90 days as the primary outcome and predictive models utilizing imaging biomarkers from CT or MRI. Quality assessment of the included studies was conducted using the PROBAST and and METhodological RadiomICs Score (METRICS) tools. Results Seventeen studies were included in the quantitative meta-analysis. Models demonstrated good prognostic performance for 90-day outcomes, with pooled AUCs of 0.85 (95% CI: 0.80-0.86) for internal and 0.74 (95% CI: 0.67-0.89) for external validation sets, with no significant difference (p=0.42). Deep learning and hand-crafted radiomics models showed comparable diagnostic accuracy in the primary analysis (p=0.667); a difference in sensitivity favouring hand-crafted radiomics emerged only in a post-hoc analysis after exclusion of one outlier study. Models incorporating clinical variables significantly outperformed imaging-only models (p<0.01). CT- and MRI-based models showed similar performance. Treatment-specific analyses revealed higher sensitivity for IVT-based models and higher specificity for combined MT+IVT models. Conclusions DL and HCR models demonstrate robust potential for predicting 90-day outcomes in ischemic stroke. Future research should focus on standardizing model evaluation metrics and incorporating explainable AI techniques to improve clinical applicability.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；clinical】系统综述和 Meta 分析纳入 17 项研究，比较深度学习和手工构建放射组学对缺血性卒中 90 天 mRS 结局的预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时报告内部和外部验证、模型类型及影像与临床变量的差异，提供较高层级的综合证据；异质性和标准化问题仍限制临床转化。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：准确预测缺血性卒中后的 90 天结局对于优化临床策略至关重要。本研究旨在系统综述并 Meta 分析使用深度学习（DL）和手工构建放射组学（HCR）模型预测缺血性卒中后 90 天改良 Rankin 量表（mRS）结局的研究。方法：我们遵循系统综述的 PRISMA 指南。全面检索 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science 和 Cochrane Library 四个数据库，检索截至 2025 年 9 月发表的研究。纳入标准包括：以缺血性卒中患者为对象、以 90 天 mRS 为主要结局，并使用 CT 或 MRI 影像生物标志物的预测模型原始研究。使用 PROBAST 和方法学放射组学评分（METRICS）工具对纳入研究进行质量评估。结果：共有 17 项研究纳入定量 Meta 分析。模型对 90 天结局显示出良好的预后性能，内部验证集和外部验证集的合并 AUC 分别为 0.85（95% CI：0.80-0.86）和 0.74（95% CI：0.67-0.89），两者无显著差异（p=0.42）。在主要分析中，深度学习和手工构建放射组学模型的诊断准确性相当（p=0.667）；仅在排除一项离群研究的事后分析中，才出现有利于手工构建放射组学的敏感性差异。纳入临床变量的模型显著优于仅使用影像的模型（p<0.01）。基于 CT 和 MRI 的模型性能相似。治疗特异性分析显示，静脉溶栓（IVT）模型的敏感性更高，联合机械取栓+静脉溶栓（MT+IVT）模型的特异性更高。结论：深度学习和手工构建放射组学模型在预测缺血性卒中 90 天结局方面显示出稳健潜力。未来研究应重点标准化模型评估指标，并纳入可解释 AI 技术，以提高临床适用性。

items.title: PlantGeneAnn: a high-accuracy ab initio plant gene annotation tool fine-tuned from a genome foundation model
items.abstract_or_text: Structural annotation remains a bottleneck for translating the growing catalog of high-quality plant genomes into biological insights, as current pipelines rely on RNA-seq and homologous protein evidence that are often unavailable for non-model species. Existing ab initio tools are constrained by model scale and perform poorly in complex plant genomic regions. We present PlantGeneAnn, a plant-optimized ab initio gene annotation tool fine-tuned from a genome foundation model. It combines a Mamba-MoE DNA encoder with a U-Net-style embedding decoder and a semi-Markov decoding pipeline. Trained on 40 angiosperm species, PlantGeneAnn establishes a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) across a stringent 20-species benchmark, significantly outperforming Helixer, Tiberius, and ANNEVO at exon-, intron-, and locus-levels, with mean F1 scores of 0.856, 0.880, and 0.707, respectively. It also enables efficient customized fine-tuning: LoRA fine-tuning increased the locus-level F1 of the out-of-distribution bryophyte Physcomitrium patens from 0.581 to 0.736, with performance plateauing at 40% of the fine-tuning data. Notably, PlantGeneAnn requires substantially lower peak memory usage than other baseline tools, allowing annotation of large plant genomes on standard personal workstations. PlantGeneAnn thus provides accurate, hardware-friendly ab initio annotation for diverse plant genomes, particularly newly assembled genomes, population-scale projects, and non-model plants.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】PlantGeneAnn 从基因组基础模型微调而来，在 40 个被子植物物种训练、20 个物种基准上达到高精度，并支持普通工作站上的大基因组注释。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在外部分布的苔藓 Physcomitrium patens 上，LoRA 将 locus-level F1 从 0.581 提升到 0.736；同时报告内存优势和可复现基准。
items.abstract_zh: 结构注释仍是将不断增加的高质量植物基因组目录转化为生物学洞见的瓶颈，因为现有流程依赖 RNA-seq 和同源蛋白证据，而这些证据在非模式物种中往往不可获得。现有从头工具受模型规模限制，在复杂植物基因组区域中的表现较差。我们提出 PlantGeneAnn，这是一种面向植物优化的从头基因注释工具，由基因组基础模型微调而来。它结合了 Mamba-MoE DNA 编码器、U-Net 风格嵌入解码器和半马尔可夫解码流程。在 40 个被子植物物种上训练后，PlantGeneAnn 在严格的 20 物种基准上，在外显子、内含子和基因座层面均显著优于 Helixer、Tiberius 和 ANNEVO，平均 F1 分数分别为 0.856、0.880 和 0.707。它还支持高效的定制微调：LoRA 微调将分布外苔藓 Physcomitrium patens 的基因座层面 F1 从 0.581 提高到 0.736，并且当微调数据达到 40% 时性能趋于平台期。值得注意的是，与其他基线工具相比，PlantGeneAnn 所需峰值内存显著更低，因此可以在标准个人工作站上注释大型植物基因组。因此，PlantGeneAnn 能够为多样化的植物基因组提供准确且硬件友好的从头注释，尤其适用于新组装基因组、群体规模项目和非模式植物。

items.title: In Vivo Transcriptomics-Based Framework for Systematic Indication Expansion
items.abstract_or_text: Capturing the systemic effects of drugs in vivo remains a fundamental challenge for drug repurposing strategies. Here, we present an in vivo transcriptomics-based drug repurposing framework that profiles multi-organ RNA-seq from drug-treated rodents to model systemic drug responses and match tissue-specific drug signatures against a compendium of disease signatures for indication expansion. We applied this framework to semaglutide, a GLP-1 receptor agonist originally developed for diabetes and subsequently expanded for several other indications. By harmonizing more than 900 human disease transcriptomic signatures via agentic AI and using Z-transformed reversal of gene expression scoring to quantify drug-disease relationships, our approach successfully recovered established semaglutide indications while deprioritizing Alzheimers disease, an indication for which semaglutide was not effective. Top predictions for common diseases were supported by real-world electronic health record data from the Mount Sinai Health System and several predictions for rare indications are proposed for further investigation. This framework provides a scalable strategy for indication expansion across diverse therapeutic agents, especially investigational compounds for which real-world evidence remains sparse.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；in vivo】以药物处理啮齿动物的多器官 RNA-seq 建模全身药物反应，并结合 900 多个人类疾病转录组特征和 EHR 证据进行适应证扩展。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 成功恢复 semaglutide 的已知适应证，并降低未获疗效的阿尔茨海默病适应证优先级；罕见病预测仍需独立实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 捕获药物在体内的系统性效应，仍是药物再利用策略面临的根本挑战。在这里，我们提出一种基于体内转录组学的药物再利用框架：对接受药物处理的啮齿动物进行多器官 RNA-seq，建立系统性药物反应模型，并将组织特异性药物特征与疾病特征汇编进行匹配，以扩展适应证。我们将该框架应用于 semaglutide；它最初是为糖尿病开发的 GLP-1 受体激动剂，后来扩展到其他适应证。通过 agentic AI 对 900 多个人类疾病转录组特征进行协调，并使用基因表达反转的 Z 转换评分量化药物—疾病关系，我们的方法成功恢复了 semaglutide 已确立的适应证，同时降低了阿尔茨海默病的优先级；对于这一适应证，semaglutide 并未显示疗效。常见疾病的最高排名预测得到 Mount Sinai Health System 真实世界电子健康记录数据的支持，并提出了若干罕见适应证供进一步研究。该框架为在多种治疗药物之间开展适应证扩展提供了一种可扩展策略，尤其适用于真实世界证据稀少的研究性化合物。
