items.title: CloneOT: predicting clone-specific perturbation responses with lineage-supervised neural inverse optimal transport
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting single-cell perturbation responses requires mapping between two unpaired populations of cells measured before and after the perturbation. Optimal transport (OT) provides a principled framework for constructing such mappings by minimizing the transport cost, and neural OT methods (e.g., CellOT) have been employed for this prediction task. However, these methods rely on a fixed transport cost, typically the squared Euclidean distance. This cost may connect cells with the wrong responses. Lineage tracing provides the information needed to learn the cost, as heritable barcodes link the cells of the same clone before and after the perturbation. Here, we propose \CloneOT, a neural inverse OT method that learns both the transport cost and the transport map from partially lineage-traced single-cell datasets. \CloneOT\ represents the cost as a neural network. It learns the cost by minimizing the extra cost that the lineage adds to the optimal transport, so that the cheapest transport keeps the cells of each clone together. Our experiments demonstrate that \CloneOT\ recovers the correct transport on 2D datasets, while the squared Euclidean cost fails. Moreover, \CloneOT\ outperforms five baselines on 14 lineage-tracing perturbation scenarios of cancer cells, for both seen and unseen clones. Furthermore, we show that \CloneOT\ reveals the clone-specific transcriptional programs of drug-tolerant persister cells and forecasts the fate of each clone from its cells before treatment. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/poseidonchan/CloneOT.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint】CloneOT 从部分谱系追踪的单细胞数据中同时学习运输成本和运输映射，在 14 个癌细胞谱系追踪扰动场景中优于 5 个基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将谱系条形码用于学习克隆特异性扰动映射，并预测药物耐受持留细胞的克隆命运；代码公开，便于复现。
items.abstract_zh: 预测单细胞扰动响应需要在扰动前后测量的两个不配对细胞群体之间建立映射。最优传输（OT）通过最小化传输成本，为构建此类映射提供了原则性方法；神经 OT 方法（例如 CellOT）已被用于该预测任务。然而，这些方法依赖固定的传输成本，通常是平方欧氏距离。该成本可能会将细胞连接到错误的响应。谱系追踪提供了学习成本所需的信息，因为可遗传条形码能够将同一克隆在扰动前后的细胞联系起来。在这里，我们提出 CloneOT，这是一种神经逆 OT 方法，可从部分进行谱系追踪的单细胞数据集中同时学习传输成本和传输映射。CloneOT 将成本表示为神经网络。它通过最小化谱系信息对最优传输增加的额外成本来学习成本，使得代价最低的传输能够保持同一克隆的细胞聚在一起。实验显示，在二维数据集上，CloneOT 能恢复正确的传输，而平方欧氏成本则失败。此外，在 14 个癌细胞谱系追踪扰动场景中，无论是已见克隆还是未见克隆，CloneOT 都优于 5 个基线。我们进一步显示，CloneOT 能揭示药物耐受持留细胞的克隆特异性转录程序，并根据治疗前的细胞预测每个克隆的命运。实现代码可在 https://github.com/poseidonchan/CloneOT 获取。
items.author_line: Yanshuo Chen, Wei Chen, Heng Huang

items.title: CellChain: Benchmarking Cross-Scale Evidence Use for Perturbation Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Recent advances in foundation models and large-scale cellular perturbation datasets have driven growing interest in using LLMs to predict and reason about cellular responses. Biological reasoning in this setting involves relating molecular mechanisms, cellular responses, and functional outcomes across scales. Evaluating foundation models therefore requires assessing not only whether their predictions are correct, but also how those predictions depend on the biological evidence provided. We introduce CellChain, an experimentally grounded benchmark comprising 590 biological cases and 2,360 matched evidence-condition instances across gene-dependency prediction, cytokine-axis identification, and drug-sensitivity ranking. CellChain links perturbation experiments and external biological resources through a provenance-aware evidence graph spanning molecular, pathway, transcriptional, and phenotypic information. Task-specific conditions vary evidence coverage, composition, or assignment while preserving questions, candidate answers, reference targets, and scoring rules. Across 18 foundation models, the highest accuracies under prespecified target-evidence conditions are 57.5%, 75.5%, and 70.8%, respectively, and broader evidence coverage does not consistently improve accuracy. On the drug-sensitivity benchmark cohort, matched reference histories outperform swapped histories by an average of 13.0 percentage points in cluster-weighted accuracy. Decision-transition analysis separates corrections, newly introduced errors, and wrong-answer switches, revealing substantial answer changes hidden by small net accuracy differences. CellChain provides controlled comparisons for attributing changes in model predictions to prespecified expansions of biological context, including changes in evidence coverage, composition, and biological assignment.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；benchmark】CellChain 包含 590 个生物学案例和 2,360 个证据条件实例，评估基础模型在基因依赖、细胞因子轴和药物敏感性任务中如何使用跨尺度证据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 通过来源可追溯的证据图和受控证据替换，区分模型预测变化来自证据覆盖、组成还是生物学归属，为生物医学模型评测提供更细粒度的因果归因框架。
items.abstract_zh: 基础模型和大规模细胞扰动数据集的近期进展，推动了使用大型语言模型预测和推理细胞响应的兴趣。在这种场景下，生物学推理需要跨尺度联系分子机制、细胞响应和功能结局。因此，对基础模型的评估不仅要考察预测是否正确，还要考察这些预测如何依赖所提供的生物学证据。我们提出 CellChain，这是一个以实验为基础的基准，包含 590 个生物学案例和 2,360 个匹配的证据—条件实例，涵盖基因依赖预测、细胞因子轴识别和药物敏感性排序。CellChain 通过一个可追溯来源的证据图，将扰动实验和外部生物学资源连接起来，该图覆盖分子、通路、转录和表型信息。任务条件在保持问题、候选答案、参考目标和评分规则不变的情况下，改变证据覆盖范围、组成或分配。在 18 个基础模型中，在预先规定的目标—证据条件下，三个任务的最高准确率分别为 57.5%、75.5% 和 70.8%；更广泛的证据覆盖并不总能提高准确率。在药物敏感性基准队列中，匹配的参考历史相比置换后的历史，使按簇加权的准确率平均提高 13.0 个百分点。决策转换分析区分了纠正、新引入的错误和错误答案之间的切换，揭示出小的净准确率差异可能掩盖大量答案变化。CellChain 提供了受控比较，用于将模型预测的变化归因于预先规定的生物学背景扩展，包括证据覆盖、证据组成和生物学分配的变化。
items.author_line: Xue Xia, Yue Wang, Shuizhou Chen, Lang Yu, Hao Wu, Wenxuan Huang, Chengkai Yao, Zhangyang Gao, Siqi Sun

items.title: MedHarnessBench: A Unified Benchmark for Healthcare Agent Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Healthcare agents must transform longitudinal clinical evidence into reliable actions through heterogeneous tools and stateful workflows, conditions under which model-centric systems may lose context, misuse tools, fail to verify consequential transitions, or cross authorization boundaries. Existing medical-agent benchmarks primarily emphasize terminal task outcomes, making it difficult to determine whether execution failures arise from the agent model, the runtime harness, or their interaction. We present the Medical Harness Protocol, an outcome-preserving framework that independently evaluates seven healthcare-specific process dimensions: Care Action Fulfillment, Clinical Resource Competence, Patient-Evidence Alignment, Clinical Workflow Continuity, Clinical Auditability, Closed-Loop Verification, and Clinical Conduct Boundaries. A normalized intervention trace further tracks whether runtime support is available, activated, delivered, adopted by the agent, and propagated into subsequent behavior. We instantiate the protocol as MedHarnessBench, comprising 342 executable tasks across FHIR/EHR operations, healthcare-administration interfaces, and multimodal clinical tools. Across more than 16,000 controlled task executions, MedHarness yields broad improvements in terminal task success, intermediate subtask completion, and healthcare-specific process quality. We further evaluate MedHarness against multiple general-purpose harnesses and use controlled single-fault perturbations to verify the sensitivity and discrimination of the seven-dimensional evaluation. These results demonstrate that healthcare-specific runtime support can substantially improve both task completion and execution quality, while revealing failures that terminal outcomes alone cannot capture. Code and resources are available at https://github.com/Tomry1114/Awesome-Agent-Harness-for-Healthcare.
items.summary_zh: 【preprint；clinical benchmark】MedHarnessBench 以 342 个可执行任务和超过 16,000 次受控执行，评估医疗智能体的行动完成、证据对齐、审计、闭环验证和边界遵守。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把终端成功拆解为七个医疗流程维度，并用单故障扰动检验敏感性；代码和资源公开，适合复现和安全评测。
items.abstract_zh: 医疗智能体必须将纵向临床证据转化为可靠行动，这一过程涉及异构工具和有状态工作流；在这些条件下，以模型为中心的系统可能丢失上下文、误用工具、无法验证重要状态转换，或越过授权边界。现有医疗智能体基准主要强调终端任务结果，因此难以判断执行失败源于智能体模型、运行时工具框架，还是二者的交互。我们提出医疗工具框架协议（Medical Harness Protocol），这是一个不改变结果的框架，可独立评估七个医疗特异性流程维度：护理行动完成、临床资源能力、患者—证据对齐、临床工作流连续性、临床可审计性、闭环验证和临床行为边界。归一化干预轨迹进一步追踪运行时支持是否可用、是否被激活、是否交付、是否被智能体采用，以及是否传播到后续行为。我们将该协议实例化为 MedHarnessBench，其中包含 342 个涉及 FHIR/EHR 操作、医疗管理界面和多模态临床工具的可执行任务。在超过 16,000 次受控任务执行中，MedHarness 在终端任务成功率、中间子任务完成率和医疗特异性流程质量方面均带来广泛改善。我们还将 MedHarness 与多个通用工具框架进行比较，并使用受控的单故障扰动验证七维评估的敏感性和区分能力。这些结果表明，医疗特异性运行时支持可以显著改善任务完成和执行质量，同时揭示出仅靠终端结果无法发现的失败。代码和资源可在 https://github.com/Tomry1114/Awesome-Agent-Harness-for-Healthcare 获取。
items.author_line: Rui Tang, Hongqiu Wang

items.title: TLA-Verus: Generating and Solving Temporal Proof Obligations with LLM Agents
items.abstract_or_text: The TLA+ (temporal logic of actions) formal specification toolkit has seen widespread adoption in modeling modern distributed software systems including databases, storage systems, ledgers and coordination protocols. This popularity is despite its two significant limitations for software verification: Firstly, TLA+ offers no way to detect drift between software implementation and mathematical specification; secondly, TLC and TLAPS cannot provide satisfactory proofs of arbitrary temporal logic properties. We take a step towards addressing these shortcomings by translating TLA+ specifications into Verus, an auto-active verifier built for Rust, via both a deterministic transpiler and an agentic translator. We demonstrate that our LLM-based pipeline is able to generate proof obligations from TLA+ specifications at scale, and to produce fully machine checkable proofs of both safety and liveness properties. Since temporal logic reasoning in Verus is a largely new task for LLMs, our work yields a valuable evaluation dataset, which we use to map out current generation model capabilities in Verus theorem proving.
items.summary_zh: TLA-Verus 将 TLA+ 规约转译为 Verus 证明义务，并用 LLM agent 生成安全性与活性证明。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务边界清晰，结果以机器可检查证明和专门评测数据集验证，可直接衡量 LLM 在 Verus 时序定理证明上的能力。
items.abstract_zh: TLA+（temporal logic of actions，动作时序逻辑）形式规约工具包已广泛用于数据库、存储系统、账本和协调协议等现代分布式软件系统的建模，尽管它在软件验证方面有两个重要局限：第一，TLA+ 无法检测软件实现与数学规约之间的偏移；第二，TLC 和 TLAPS 无法为任意时序逻辑性质提供令人满意的证明。我们通过将 TLA+ 规约转换为 Verus——一种为 Rust 构建的自动主动式验证器——来改进这一点，转换同时采用确定性转译器和 agent 式翻译器。我们展示了基于 LLM 的流水线能够大规模生成证明义务，并为安全性和活性性质产生完全可机器检查的证明。由于在 Verus 中进行时序逻辑推理对 LLM 而言基本上是新任务，我们还构建了有价值的评测数据集，用于描绘当前模型在 Verus 定理证明方面的能力。
items.author_line: Kseniia Strelbytska, Balázs Szilágyi, Anna Mészáros, Ferenc Huszár

items.title: Beyond LLM Judge: Mechanical Verification for Agentic Autoformalization
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce a novel method for verifying Lean formalizations that goes beyond LLM-judged faithfulness. Unlike most verification methods, which rely on LLMs or trained models, our method combines LLM-based semantic review with mechanical numerical and vacuity checks, providing checkable feedback and detecting errors missed by LLM judges. We apply this method, along with our Extract-Verify-Proof autoformalization pipeline, to construct the Formalized Library of Mathematical Functions (FLMF), a partial formalization of the NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions (DLMF). On three labeled datasets, our method achieves the lowest accepted-error rate among the evaluated methods, measured as the fraction of incorrect statements accepted by the verification method. Expert review of the results also identifies translation and source defects in existing datasets. Code available at https://github.com/annamei1/FLMF-Ch7ErrFunc-Release.git.
items.summary_zh: Beyond LLM Judge 将语义审查与机械数值检查、空洞性检查结合，用于验证 Lean 形式化是否忠实。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把“形式化是否表达了原意”转化为可检查的验证流程，并在三个标注数据集上报告误接受率，评测指标明确。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种验证 Lean 形式化的新方法，超越由 LLM 判断忠实性的做法。不同于主要依赖 LLM 或训练模型的多数验证方法，我们的方法将基于 LLM 的语义审查与机械数值检查和空洞性检查结合起来，提供可检查的反馈，并发现 LLM 评审遗漏的错误。我们将该方法与 Extract-Verify-Proof 自动形式化流水线结合，构建了 Mathematical Functions Formalized Library（FLMF），即 NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions（DLMF）的部分形式化。在三个带标签的数据集上，以验证方法所接受的错误陈述比例为指标，我们的方法取得了所评估方法中最低的误接受率。专家对结果的审查还发现了现有数据集中的翻译缺陷和来源缺陷。代码可见于 https://github.com/annamei1/FLMF-Ch7ErrFunc-Release.git。
items.author_line: Anna Mei, Michael R. Douglas

items.title: Compositional RL: Evaluating and Training LLMs for Collaborative Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Language models are often evaluated alone but increasingly deployed together, routed between, made to debate, ensembled, or collaboratively trained. For a model inside a system, what matters most is not how well it performs on its own, but how much the system gains from its presence. We call this a model's compositional strength and formalize it using the Shapley value of a cooperative game over coalitions of a model pool, and use a model's leave-one-out contribution to the full coalition as a tractable proxy, requiring n+1 rather than 2^n system evaluations. Evaluating individual vs. compositional strengths across five model pools, twelve collaboration methods, and twelve datasets, we find them largely uncorrelated: in 12 of 15 (pool, method-family) settings, individual strength does not translate into compositional advantages, and the coupling is weakest among general-purpose models that practitioners are most likely to deploy. Standalone benchmarks are therefore often poor proxies for models' value in collaborative systems. We then propose compositional reinforcement learning (C-RL), which trains a policy inside a live multi-model system and rewards the outcome produced by the system as a whole, rather than the policy's correctness in isolation. The leave-one-out baseline in Shapley values cancels under a group policy gradient, so this needs no additional rollout cost beyond RL on the collaborative system's outcome and never requires running a coalition without the policy. Across three collaboration protocols and eight tasks spanning reasoning, coding, and scientific discovery, C-RL produces the strongest collaborator in 21 of 24 settings, lifting collaborative performance by +4.0 to +5.4 pts on average (~3x the gain of baselines), up to +13.1 pts.
items.summary_zh: Compositional RL 用 Shapley 值与留一法定义模型在协作系统中的贡献，并训练面向整体协作结果的策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在五个模型池、十二种协作方法和十二个数据集上区分个体能力与组合能力，报告了可复现实验规模和性能增益。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型通常被单独评估，但越来越多地被共同部署、相互路由、进行辩论、集成或协同训练。对于系统中的一个模型，最重要的不是它单独表现多好，而是系统因其存在获得了多少收益。我们将模型的这种能力称为组合能力，并用模型池上合作博弈的 Shapley 值形式化；同时用对完整联盟的留一贡献作为可处理的代理指标，将所需系统评估次数从 2^n 降为 n+1。在五个模型池、十二种协作方法和十二个数据集上评估个体能力与组合能力后，我们发现二者总体不相关：在 15 个（模型池、方法族）设置中的 12 个里，个体能力并未转化为组合优势；而且在实践者最可能部署的通用模型中，这种耦合最弱。因此，单独基准往往不是模型在协作系统中价值的良好代理。随后我们提出组合强化学习（C-RL），它在实时多模型系统中训练策略，并奖励系统整体产生的结果，而不是策略单独的正确性。Shapley 值中的留一基线在群体策略梯度下相消，因此除在协作系统结果上进行 RL 外无需额外 rollout 成本，也不需要运行缺少该策略的联盟。在三种协作协议和覆盖推理、编码及科学发现的八项任务上，C-RL 在 24 个设置中的 21 个产生了最强的协作者，使协作性能平均提升 4.0 至 5.4 个百分点（约为基线增益的 3 倍），最高提升 13.1 个百分点。
items.author_line: Shangbin Feng, Yulia Tsvetkov, Jan Kautz, David Acuna

items.title: Anchors Enhance Controllability and Reasoning of Diffusion Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer new opportunities for controllable text generation. However, their controllability, defined as the ability to satisfy task constraints while preserving their original capabilities, remains underexplored. DLMs' bidirectional attention allows control tokens to guide generation from arbitrary positions in the output sequence, but effective guidance depends on the compatibility between their content and placement. To this end, we propose AnchorDLM, a framework in which an anchor generator produces an anchor consisting of a short output fragment and its position for each query. The anchor is placed as control tokens at the specified position to initialize the output sequence of a frozen DLM and guide subsequent denoising. We train the anchor generator with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly optimize anchor content and placement, using rewards computed from the DLM's generated outputs based on answer correctness and constraint satisfaction. Moreover, through the lens of discrete flow matching (DFM), we interpret anchor placement as helping to reshape the initial velocity field that guides generation. Experiments on code generation and mathematical reasoning across five DLM backbones show that AnchorDLM improves controllability and further yields gains in reasoning performance across diverse benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: AnchorDLM 通过学习锚点内容与位置控制扩散语言模型，并在数学推理和代码生成基准上评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 控制目标、奖励函数和五个 DLM backbone 的实验设置清楚，能检验约束满足与推理性能是否同时改善。
items.abstract_zh: 扩散语言模型（DLM）为可控文本生成提供了新的机会。然而，它们的可控性——即满足任务约束同时保持原有能力的能力——仍未得到充分研究。DLM 的双向注意力允许控制 token 从输出序列的任意位置引导生成，但有效引导取决于其内容与放置位置是否兼容。为此，我们提出 AnchorDLM：锚点生成器针对每个查询生成一个由短输出片段及其位置组成的锚点。锚点作为控制 token 被放置在指定位置，用于初始化冻结 DLM 的输出序列并引导后续去噪。我们使用强化学习（RL）训练锚点生成器，根据 DLM 生成结果的答案正确性和约束满足情况计算奖励，从而联合优化锚点内容与位置。此外，我们从离散流匹配（DFM）的角度解释锚点放置，认为它有助于重塑引导生成的初始速度场。在五个 DLM backbone 上针对代码生成和数学推理进行的实验表明，AnchorDLM 提升了可控性，并在多种基准上进一步提高了推理性能。
items.author_line: Feiyu Qu, Zheng Huang, Andrea Zanette

items.title: RuleTrek: Benchmarking Agentic Rule Reasoning in Complex Scenarios
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly tackle complex real-world tasks in specialized domains. However, identifying and correctly applying domain-specific rules remains challenging when scenario information is distributed across multiple files. Existing rule-reasoning benchmarks typically represent scenarios using only a few factual statements, simplifying the identification and application of relevant rules. To address this gap, this paper introduces RuleTrek, a multi-domain benchmark for agentic rule reasoning in complex scenarios. Its rule-grounded construction pipeline extracts structured rule graphs, generates and incrementally composes rule-specific sub-scenarios while ensuring consistency and solvability. To systematically evaluate agentic rule reasoning in complex scenarios, RuleTrek assesses three capabilities in interactive workspaces: Rule Identification (RI), Rule Deduction (RD), and End-to-End Rule Reasoning (E2E). Experiments on 11 frontier LLMs show that the highest RI and RD scores are only 62.47\% and 60.43\%, respectively, while E2E scores range from 26.97\% to 55.29\%. These results demonstrate that current LLM agents face substantial challenges in rule reasoning over complex scenarios. We make our code and dataset publicly available at https://github.com/yuan247/RuleTrek{RuleTrek}.
items.summary_zh: RuleTrek 构建跨领域复杂场景的 agent 规则推理基准，分别评测规则识别、规则演绎和端到端推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 规则图、可解性约束和交互式工作空间使任务可复核；11 个前沿 LLM 的分项结果显示当前模型仍有明显短板。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地处理专业领域中的复杂现实任务。然而，当场景信息分散在多个文件中时，识别并正确应用领域规则仍然困难。现有规则推理基准通常只用少量事实陈述表示场景，简化了相关规则的识别与应用。为弥补这一缺口，本文提出 RuleTrek，一个面向复杂场景 agent 规则推理的跨领域基准。其基于规则的构建流水线抽取结构化规则图，生成并逐步组合特定于规则的子场景，同时确保一致性和可解性。为系统评估复杂场景中的 agent 规则推理，RuleTrek 在交互式工作空间中评测三种能力：规则识别（RI）、规则演绎（RD）以及端到端规则推理（E2E）。对 11 个前沿 LLM 的实验显示，最高 RI 和 RD 得分分别只有 62.47% 和 60.43%，E2E 得分范围为 26.97% 至 55.29%。这些结果表明，当前 LLM agent 在复杂场景上的规则推理仍面临显著挑战。代码和数据集公开于 https://github.com/yuan247/RuleTrek{RuleTrek}。
items.author_line: Chenhao Yuan, Bohan Yu, Yinhao Xu, Chao Yin, Chenxi Zhou, Zhaoxuan Wang, Shuwen Xu, Shaoping Huang, Haolin Ren, Jiaxiang Liu, Yao Xu, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu

items.title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents
items.abstract_or_text: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
items.summary_zh: HybridAgents 在隐式推理与文本交互之间动态切换，结合工具调用、可检查的潜在思维和多轮工作记忆。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 覆盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和 agent 推理的 11 个基准，并同时报告性能、token、速度和成本变化。
items.abstract_zh: 如何构建一种超越人类语言进行思考、却仍通过语言与外部环境交互的 agent？现代 LLM agent 仍通过文本进行推理和交互；潜在推理提供了高效的内部媒介，却缺少原生工具访问和推理透明度。我们提出 Hybrid Reasoning Agents（HybridAgents），在统一生成过程中动态地在潜在推理与基于文本的交互之间切换。架构上，轻量级 HybridLink 实现文本模式与潜在模式之间的无缝转换，而 agent 的连续工作记忆在多轮交互中保留无损的混合上下文。这些设计保留了工具集成的 agent 能力，同时使潜在思维可以直接检查。在此架构基础上，我们进一步提出面向混合推理的专用后训练算法：HybridSFT 通过教会 backbone 与 HybridLink 协同工作来稳定工具集成的混合生成，HybridRL 则学习何时在潜在空间中思考、何时通过文本行动。我们在 3 个模型规模、覆盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和 agent 推理的 11 个基准上评估 HybridAgent。与同时涵盖文本和潜在方法的前沿 LLM Agent 及 agent 框架相比，HybridAgent 的性能稳定提升 10.4%，同时 token 数减少 35.5%–54.7%，推理速度提高 1.8–2.6 倍，成本降低 2.7–3.7 倍。代码和数据见 https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent。
items.author_line: Jiaru Zou, Yunzhe Qi, Sirui Chen, Federico Bianchi, Shang Zhu, Pan Lu, Jingrui He, James Zou

items.title: One Monitor Does Not Fit All: Formalism-Agnostic Runtime Verification for Agentic AI
items.abstract_or_text: Agentic AI systems combine model decisions, mutable state, tool calls, and delegation to external agents. Monitoring them requires observations from different execution boundaries, while prevention requires control before an operation produces its effect. We present AgenticRV, a runtime-verification architecture that separates these boundaries from the monitoring formalism. Adapters emit canonical events; each monitor receives its own projection and abstraction; and a decision policy uses normalised verdicts to select a reaction supported by the responsible adapter. We formalise when observations suffice, monitor replacement preserves decisions, and blocking prevents unsafe effects. We also distinguish rejected attempts from completed effects, avoiding the assumption that a blocked request must leave every monitor in a permanent violation state. The Python implementation supports LangGraph, MCP, and A2A. A controlled LangGraph experiment combines an external Reelay temporal monitor with a programmatic report monitor; ablations show why both are needed for the selected requirements. Differential checks and cross-adapter tests provide further integration evidence. An LLM-driven incident-response example illustrates the same enforcement path, while existing microbenchmarks isolate framework costs. The results support reuse of monitoring methods at explicit control boundaries, subject to the stated observation and deployment assumptions.
items.summary_zh: AgenticRV 将观测边界、监视形式化和阻断策略解耦，为 LangGraph、MCP 和 A2A 提供运行时验证实现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 形式化说明观测充分性、监视器替换和阻断语义，并通过消融、差分检查和跨适配器测试验证集成行为。
items.abstract_zh: Agentic AI 系统结合了模型决策、可变状态、工具调用以及向外部 agent 的委派。对其进行监控需要来自不同执行边界的观测，而预防则需要在操作产生影响之前进行控制。我们提出 AgenticRV，一种与监视形式化无关的运行时验证架构，将这些边界分离开来：适配器发出规范化事件；每个监视器接收自己的投影和抽象；决策策略使用规范化的判定结果，选择由负责的适配器支持的反应。我们形式化了观测何时足够、监视器替换何时保持决策不变，以及阻断如何防止不安全影响。我们区分被拒绝的尝试与已完成的影响，避免假设被阻断的请求必须使每个监视器永久处于违规状态。Python 实现支持 LangGraph、MCP 和 A2A。受控的 LangGraph 实验将外部 Reelay 时序监视器与程序化报告监视器结合起来；消融实验说明二者对于所选需求为何都不可或缺。差分检查和跨适配器测试进一步提供了集成证据。一个由 LLM 驱动的事件响应示例展示了相同的执行路径，而现有微基准则单独测量了框架开销。结果支持在明确控制边界上复用监视方法，但前提是满足文中所述的观测和部署假设。
items.author_line: Angelo Ferrando

items.title: Beyond Answer Voting: Fine-Grained Correction of LLM Reasoning through Graph Alignment across Sampled Traces
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models increasingly tackle tasks that require multi-step reasoning, where errors in intermediate claims can affect the final answer. Self-consistency (SC) improves reasoning by voting over sampled final answers, but its vote leaves intermediate disagreements unresolved. To address this problem, we introduce DDRG (Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs), a framework for selective correction from a frozen bank of reasoning traces. Our insight is that graph alignment can expose claim-level disagreements and provide correction evidence without expanding the sampled trace bank. DDRG builds source-grounded claim graphs and sends localized conflicts to an answer-blind verifier. A verifier-supported refutation that reaches the majority answer's supporting path triggers one focused repair; otherwise, DDRG returns the exact SC vote. Experimental results across five benchmarks show that native zero-shot DDRG improves macro-average accuracy over direct answering by 8.65 and 15.83 percentage points for Qwen2.5-7B and Llama3.1-8B. It also exceeds CoT, the evaluated GoT and GoV question-answering adaptations, and SC on this macro metric. DDRG links local verification to selective correction without enlarging the initial candidate bank.
items.summary_zh: DDRG 将多条推理轨迹对齐为声明图，定位局部冲突并进行一次选择性修复，避免盲目扩增采样轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在五个基准上以宏平均准确率比较直接回答、CoT、GoT、GoV 和自洽投票，验证指标和对照清晰。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地处理需要多步推理的任务，其中间声明的错误会影响最终答案。自洽性（SC）通过对采样得到的最终答案投票来改进推理，但投票无法解决中间步骤之间的分歧。为此，我们提出 DDRG（Disagreement-Driven Verification Guided by Reasoning Graphs），一种从冻结的推理轨迹库中进行选择性纠错的框架。我们的关键观察是，图对齐能够暴露声明级分歧，并在不扩大采样轨迹库的情况下提供纠错证据。DDRG 构建基于来源的声明图，并将局部冲突发送给不查看答案的验证器。如果验证器支持的反驳能够到达多数答案的支持路径，系统就触发一次聚焦式修复；否则，DDRG 返回原本的 SC 投票。在五个基准上的实验中，原生零样本 DDRG 相对于直接回答，在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Llama3.1-8B 上的宏平均准确率分别提高 8.65 和 15.83 个百分点。它还超过了 CoT、所评估的 GoT 和 GoV 问答改编方法以及 SC。DDRG 将局部验证与选择性纠错连接起来，同时不增加初始候选轨迹库。
items.author_line: Haotian Liu, Yingjian Chen, Xiaohang Xu, Lang Huang, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Irene Li

items.title: Do Theorem Provers Need Theorem-Proving Agents? mini-Lean-agent: A Coding-Agent Baseline for Lean
items.abstract_or_text: General-purpose coding agents use standard shell and file interactions, yet formal theorem-proving agents often rely on specialized, ad-hoc tooling. This makes it difficult to determine which components of theorem-proving agents provide benchmark gains: an improved base model, a specialized harness, a specific tool, or a combination of any of them. We introduce mini-Lean-agent, a deliberately minimal agent for Lean tasks whose only model-visible tool is bash. The model must use bash to inspect and edit the repository, search local libraries, invoke Lean, and manage its own intermediate work, while a separate trusted evaluator verifies the final artifact. We compare mini-Lean-agent against AxProverBase and Numina-Lean-Agent on the Putnam 2025 benchmark. Experiments with Gemini 3.8 Flash as the base model show that mini-Lean-agent solves 7/12 problems at \2 per problem limit, compared with AxProverBase's 4/12. With Astra as the base model, mini-Lean-agent solves 12/12 problems at an average cost of \1.28 per problem. This suggests that a generic coding agent with a minimal harness can already achieve strong performance on Lean benchmarks. Our results motivate using mini-Lean-agent as a standard baseline when evaluating theorem-proving infrastructure.
items.summary_zh: mini-Lean-agent 只向模型提供 bash 工具，让通用 coding agent 自行检索库、调用 Lean 并提交由可信评估器检查的证明。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 Putnam 2025 基准上与专用 theorem-proving agent 对比，证明助手基础设施的收益可以用统一任务和成本指标检验。
items.abstract_zh: 通用 coding agent 使用标准 shell 和文件交互，而形式化定理证明 agent 往往依赖专门的临时工具。这使得人们难以判断基准增益究竟来自更好的基础模型、专门 harness、特定工具，还是它们的组合。我们提出 mini-Lean-agent，这是一个有意保持最小化的 Lean 任务 agent，模型可见的唯一工具是 bash。模型必须使用 bash 检查和编辑仓库、搜索本地库、调用 Lean，并管理自己的中间工作；另有独立的可信评估器验证最终产物。我们在 Putnam 2025 基准上将 mini-Lean-agent 与 AxProverBase 和 Numina-Lean-Agent 进行比较。以 Gemini 3.8 Flash 为基础模型的实验表明，在每题 2 美元的限制下，mini-Lean-agent 解出 12 题中的 7 题，而 AxProverBase 解出 4 题。以 Astra 为基础模型时，mini-Lean-agent 解出全部 12 题，平均每题成本为 1.28 美元。这表明，配备最小 harness 的通用 coding agent 已能在 Lean 基准上取得较强表现。我们的结果支持把 mini-Lean-agent 作为评估定理证明基础设施的标准基线。
items.author_line: Tomas Ortega, Simon Park, Ayush Khaitan, Liam Fowl, Alex Kontorovich, Sanjeev Arora

items.title: Attention-Graph Curvature for the Verification of Mathematical Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Language models have recently solved open Erdős problems and achieved gold-medal level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad problems. But their solutions, written in natural language, cannot yet be verified by proof assistants. An erroneous reasoning step can invalidate every step that comes after, so it is advantageous to detect errors early. Several methods have been proposed to detect erroneous reasoning quickly based on the features of the forward pass of the language model that performs reasoning. In this work, we study whether the directed Forman curvature of that model's attention graph, a local quantity computed at an edge from the attention weights around it, carries information about a step's correctness. To do so, we evaluate four per-step verifiers on ProcessBench with and without the curvature appended to their input. Appending curvature values improves the overall mean performance of all four verifiers. ReProbe, the verifier that takes every token of a step as input, shows the largest improvement. Adding the curvature increases the time of the language model's forward pass by 18% on average.
items.summary_zh: 研究将语言模型注意力图的有向 Forman 曲率加入逐步验证器，用于早期检测数学推理中的错误步骤。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 ProcessBench 上对四个逐步验证器进行有无曲率特征的对照，结果可检验且同时报告额外计算开销。
items.abstract_zh: 近期语言模型已经解决开放的 Erdős 问题，并在国际数学奥林匹克竞赛题上达到金牌级表现。但它们以自然语言写出的解答目前仍无法由证明助手验证。由于一个错误的推理步骤会使其后的所有步骤失效，因此尽早检测错误是有利的。已有若干方法尝试根据执行推理的语言模型前向传播特征快速检测错误。本文研究该模型注意力图的有向 Forman 曲率是否包含有关某一步正确性的信息；这是一个在边上计算的局部量，由边周围的注意力权重得到。为此，我们在 ProcessBench 上评估四个逐步验证器，比较将曲率附加到输入前后的表现。加入曲率值提高了四个验证器的总体平均性能。以每一步所有 token 作为输入的验证器 ReProbe 获得的提升最大。加入曲率使语言模型前向传播时间平均增加 18%。
items.author_line: Kanghyeon Kim, Johannes F. Lutzeyer, Yanzhu Guo

items.title: Euler: Towards Human-Centered Multi-Agent Mathematical Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Mathematical research drives scientific discovery, and recent advances in AI for mathematics have shown that language-model agents can solve challenging problems and develop substantial mathematical proofs. Yet much of today's AI-for-mathematics work centers on obtaining a final answer. This emphasis leaves the exploration behind a result difficult for researchers to understand, while long-running investigations face fragmented context and the risk of unsupported claims propagating across reasoning steps. We present Euler, a human-centered mathematical research system built around a shared, structured representation of the research process. Euler organizes mathematical statements, assumptions, proof dependencies, alternative approaches, failed attempts, and verification evidence into connected research graphs. This representation allows researchers to trace how results are developed and supplies agents with persistent, task-relevant knowledge for planning, collaboration, and verification across sessions. Researchers can also select a graph node linked to a saved team state, revisit the agents' earlier reasoning, and explore alternative directions through continued interaction. We illustrate Euler's capabilities through three mathematical research case studies and describe the implemented system and its software validation.
items.summary_zh: Euler 用共享研究图记录数学陈述、假设、证明依赖、失败尝试和验证证据，支持人类研究者追踪多 agent 探索。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 重点是可追溯的研究过程表示而非只看最终答案，论文给出三个数学案例和软件验证说明。
items.abstract_zh: 数学研究推动科学发现，近期 AI for mathematics 的进展表明，语言模型 agent 能解决具有挑战性的问题并形成实质性的数学证明。然而，当前大量 AI for mathematics 工作集中于获得最终答案，使研究者难以理解结果背后的探索过程；长时间研究还会面临上下文碎片化以及无支持的声明沿推理步骤传播的风险。我们提出 Euler，一个以人为中心的多 agent 数学发现系统，围绕共享的结构化研究过程表示构建。Euler 将数学陈述、假设、证明依赖、替代方法、失败尝试和验证证据组织为相互连接的研究图。这种表示使研究者能够追踪结果的形成过程，并让 agent 在跨会话的规划、协作和验证中获得持久且与任务相关的知识。研究者还可以选择一个与已保存团队状态相连的图节点，重新查看 agent 先前的推理，并通过继续交互探索替代方向。我们通过三个数学研究案例展示 Euler 的能力，并描述已实现的系统及其软件验证。
items.author_line: Qiuyu Chen, Qi Wang, Liang Xu, Xin Jin, Baao Xie, Wenjun Zeng

items.title: Evaluating Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models: Event Temporal Relation Extraction with Allen's Interval Algebra, Logical Consistency, and Relative Time in Narratives
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding a narrative means knowing how every event relates in time to every other, yet large language models (LLMs) are mostly tested on isolated event pairs or coarse labels. We ask five LLMs to reconstruct the complete network of Allen's 13 interval relations for 360 English narratives whose events are placed relative to one another rather than by dates, and evaluate the outputs under a pre-registered protocol for agreement with our gold annotations, converse consistency and logical satisfiability. End to end, the best model clearly beats trivial baselines on macro-F1, our primary metric, yet under our pre-registered parser no model matches the accuracy of always answering "before", which the skewed labels inflate. Most of that accuracy gap is a parsing artifact: formatting errors in large matrices cost whole rows, and a post hoc parser that recovers the determined cells of malformed rows raises coverage from 0.60 to 0.84 and closes the gap to the baseline for the best model. On the cells they do answer, models recover precedence and containment but rarely overlap, and they fail most on flashbacks, where both the narration and the event list present the later event first. Logical consistency varies widely yet says little about agreement with gold: enforcing it raises accuracy mainly by filling empty cells, and is beaten there by the trivial control of guessing the majority label. Reliable structured output and robust handling of relative time are prerequisites for temporal reasoning over whole narratives.
items.summary_zh: 该研究用 Allen 的 13 种区间关系评测 LLM 对叙事事件时间网络的重建，并检查金标准一致性、逆关系一致性和逻辑可满足性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 预注册评测暴露了类别偏斜、解析失败和闪回场景等具体误差来源，避免把格式问题误判为数学推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 理解叙事意味着知道每个事件与其他事件在时间上的关系，但大型语言模型（LLM）大多只在孤立的事件对或粗粒度标签上接受测试。我们要求五个 LLM 重建 360 个英文叙事中所有事件之间的 Allen 13 种区间关系网络；这些事件按相互关系而非日期放置，并依据预注册协议，从与金标准标注的一致性、逆关系一致性和逻辑可满足性三个方面评估输出。端到端来看，最佳模型在宏平均 F1（我们的主要指标）上明显优于简单基线，但在预注册解析器下，没有模型的准确率超过始终回答“before”的方法，因为偏斜标签会抬高该基线。大部分准确率差距来自解析伪影：大型矩阵中的格式错误会使整行失分；事后解析器恢复格式错误行中可判定的单元格后，覆盖率从 0.60 提高到 0.84，并使最佳模型与基线的差距缩小。在模型实际回答的单元格上，它们能够恢复先后关系和包含关系，却很少识别重叠关系；在闪回场景中表现最差，此时叙事和事件列表都先呈现较晚事件。逻辑一致性差异很大，但对金标准的一致性几乎没有说明力：强制一致性主要通过填补空单元格来提高准确率，而在这方面还不如猜测多数标签这一简单控制。对整篇叙事进行时间推理，可靠的结构化输出和对相对时间的稳健处理是前提。
items.author_line: Adib Sakhawat, Fardeen Sadab, Tamjid Hasan Fahim, Multazam Mahmud, Tahsan Ferdous Lihan, Md Isfak Iqbal Chowdhury, Nafis Ahnaf Jamil, Md. Atik Shahriar, Sieam Shahriare, Wasi Omar Syed, M Safwan Hasan Khan, Tabib Hassan

items.title: claimcheck: Measuring and Improving Specification Faithfulness
items.abstract_or_text: Formal verification proves that a program satisfies its specification, but says nothing about whether the specification captures what the author meant. As LLMs increasingly write both code and specifications, a gap between the author's natural-language requirement and the specification becomes a live risk. A machine-checked proof of a property narrower than the one requested is worthless but passes every check. Closing this gap is solving the spec formalization problem: given a natural-language requirement, produce a formal artifact whose meaning matches it. To measure the gap, we curate an end-to-end benchmark for spec formalization spanning four formal languages: Dafny contracts and Lean 4, Isabelle and Rocq theorem statements. Each of its 3,234 rows pairs a natural-language requirement with a formal artifact and a label established by execution, by proof, or by the benchmark it is drawn from. A third of the rows are meaning-preserving rewrites of the artifact that keep the faithful label, so a judge cannot score by detecting that a row was edited. We introduce claimcheck, a tool that detects incorrect formalizations: the formal artifact is translated back into plain English by a model that never sees the requirement, and a separate model, the judge, decides whether the informalization and the requirement express the same guarantee. On all four languages it gains 8.2 to 9.8 points of macro recall over a single call shown the requirement and the artifact, and 4.2 to 6.0 over that call handed the same list of meaning-preserving rewrites. Showing the judge the artifact as well costs 1.4 to 4.5 points. Across four judges that also see the artifact, the gain shrinks as the judge gets stronger, to within a point of the informed single call for the strongest.
items.summary_zh: claimcheck 评估自然语言需求与 Dafny、Lean 4、Isabelle、Rocq 形式化产物是否表达同一保证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 3,234 条样本和意义保持改写控制了表面编辑偏差，并在四种形式语言上报告宏召回提升。
items.abstract_zh: 形式化验证可以证明程序满足其规格，但不能说明规格是否表达了作者的意图。随着 LLM 越来越多地同时编写代码和规格，自然语言需求与规格之间的差距成为现实风险。对比所要求的性质更窄的规格进行机器检查证明是没有价值的，但它仍能通过所有检查。弥合这一差距就是解决规格形式化问题：给定自然语言需求，生成一个含义与其匹配的形式化产物。为测量这一差距，我们整理了一个端到端规格形式化基准，覆盖四种形式语言：Dafny 合约、Lean 4、Isabelle 和 Rocq 定理陈述。每一行共 3,234 行数据都将自然语言需求与形式化产物配对，并带有通过执行、证明或其来源基准确定的标签。其中三分之一的行是形式化产物的意义保持改写，仍保留忠实标签，因此评审器不能仅靠检测行是否被编辑来评分。我们提出 claimcheck，一种检测错误形式化的工具：先由一个看不到需求的模型将形式化产物翻译回普通英语，再由另一个模型作为评审器判断该非形式化文本与需求是否表达相同保证。在四种语言上，与只向模型展示需求和形式化产物的一次调用相比，claimcheck 的宏平均召回率提高 8.2 至 9.8 个百分点；与将同一组意义保持改写交给该调用相比，提高 4.2 至 6.0 个百分点。若让评审器也看到形式化产物，增益下降 1.4 至 4.5 个百分点。在四个也能看到形式化产物的评审器中，随着评审器变强，增益缩小；对最强评审器而言，结果已接近知情的一次调用，差距在一个百分点以内。
items.author_line: Martin Amster, One An, Holly Baker, Fernanda Graciolli, Simon Henniger, Nada Amin

items.title: Only What You've Signed up For: Secure Workflows with Constrained Diffusion Agents
items.abstract_or_text: As agentic AI systems take on increasingly complex and consequential tasks, securing them against prompt injection becomes critical. Existing defenses often rely on detecting or reasoning about injected malicious instructions and can therefore remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks that optimize the injection itself. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), an emerging framework for language generation, offer a new opportunity for security enforcement: by iteratively refining their sequence wide predictions, they enable broader-scope constraint enforcement throughout generation. This paper introduces Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents (CoDA), a framework that enforces task dependent security policies directly within the denoising process of diffusion language models. At each denoising step, CoDA projects token distributions onto a policy-compliant set, maintaining constraint satisfaction throughout generation. We evaluate CoDA across state-of-the-art diffusion language model families under both static and adaptive prompt-injection attacks. Results demonstrate substantial reductions in attack success rate with competitive task utility and practical inference overhead.
items.summary_zh: CoDA 在扩散语言模型去噪过程中投影 token 分布，使 agent 输出持续满足任务相关安全策略，并测试静态与自适应提示注入。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 约束施加位置明确，评测同时覆盖攻击成功率、任务效用和推理开销，适合检验生成过程中的持续策略满足。
tags: 受约束生成与安全验证
items.category: 受约束生成与安全验证
items.abstract_zh: 随着 agent 式 AI 系统承担越来越复杂且后果重大的任务，防范提示注入变得至关重要。现有防御通常依赖检测或推理恶意注入指令，因此仍可能容易受到针对注入本身进行优化的自适应攻击。扩散语言模型（dLLM）是新兴的文本生成框架，它们通过迭代细化整个序列的预测，为在生成全过程中执行更大范围的约束提供了新机会。本文提出 Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents（CoDA），在扩散语言模型的去噪过程中直接执行依赖任务的安全策略。在每个去噪步骤，CoDA 将 token 分布投影到符合策略的集合中，使生成过程持续满足约束。我们在最先进的扩散语言模型系列上，同时针对静态和自适应提示注入攻击评估 CoDA。结果显示，在保持具有竞争力的任务效用和实际可用推理开销的同时，CoDA 大幅降低了攻击成功率。
items.author_line: Michael Cardei, Anjun Hu, Chenrui Ma, Francesco Pinto, Chawin Sitawarin, Chulin Xie, Ferdinando Fioretto

items.title: Exhaustive Canonical Skeletons Generation: A Formal Dataset for Decomposable Symbolic Regression
items.abstract_or_text: Neural symbolic regression (SR) models require diverse datasets of mathematical expressions for robust training. However, existing datasets rely predominantly on stochastic sampling methods, which suffer from high structural redundancy and incomplete functional coverage. To address this, we introduce an exhaustive dataset of univariate canonical skeletons generated via a deterministic constrained context-free grammar. A canonical skeleton acts as a generic structural representation that subsumes more specific functional forms, eliminating redundant expressions and avoiding repeated computational efforts. Although our dataset consists of univariate skeletons, it is designed to support the decomposable SR paradigm to solve multivariate SR problems without assuming linear separability. Furthermore, we pair this dataset with a sampling strategy that generates clean numerical data without triggering numerical instabilities or relying on artificial protected operators. Canonicalizing two existing neural SR datasets reveals that our dataset is substantially more compact, eliminates structural repetitions, and achieves a uniform operator distribution free of simplicity bias. Finally, we establish a benchmark of 150 SR problems across three tiers, on which state-of-the-art SR methods are shown to struggle significantly.
items.summary_zh: 论文用确定性受限上下文无关文法生成无结构冗余的 canonical skeleton 数据集，并建立三层、150 题的符号回归基准。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据覆盖和去重规则可检验，基准结果也明确显示现有神经符号回归方法在这些任务上仍有困难。
items.abstract_zh: 神经符号回归（SR）模型需要多样的数学表达式数据集，以实现稳健训练。然而，现有数据集主要依赖随机采样方法，存在结构冗余高和函数覆盖不完整的问题。为解决这一问题，我们引入一个由确定性受限上下文无关文法生成的一元 canonical skeleton 穷举数据集。canonical skeleton 作为一种通用结构表示，可以涵盖更具体的函数形式，从而消除冗余表达式并避免重复计算。虽然我们的数据集由一元 skeleton 组成，但它旨在支持可分解 SR 范式，用于解决多元 SR 问题，而不假设线性可分。我们还为该数据集配套一种采样策略，生成不会触发数值不稳定、也不依赖人工保护算子的干净数值数据。对两个已有神经 SR 数据集进行 canonical 化表明，我们的数据集明显更紧凑，消除了结构重复，并实现了不带简单性偏差的均匀算子分布。最后，我们建立一个包含三个层级、150 个 SR 问题的基准；在该基准上，现有最先进的 SR 方法表现出显著困难。
items.author_line: Giorgio Morales, Anikó Ekárt

items.title: Verifier-Grounded Agentic RL for Provably Correct Code
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning for code usually rewards passing tests, which a model can do while remaining wrong on the inputs the tests do not cover. A program verifier instead decides whether a program satisfies a formal specification for all inputs. Language models are almost always paired with verifiers at inference time only, and turning a verifier into a reward raises two difficulties. It reports only acceptance or rejection, which gives no gradient when every attempt fails, and a policy can cheat it, most simply by telling it to assume what the proof was supposed to establish. We build an agentic environment and reward that address both. The reward reads the verifier's diagnostics rather than its verdict, scoring a candidate by the weighted fraction of proof obligations it discharges, extended with hidden probes from a reference proof's annotations. An integrity audit outranks the verifier, rejecting any candidate that alters the specification or assumes what it was meant to prove. The model works as an agent against a live verifier over many turns, with a separately trained proof specialist as a frozen collaborator. Across Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 14B and a 35B Qwen3.6 mixture-of-experts model, held-out verification on code generation rises from 66.1% to 93.5% on DafnyBench and from 56.3% to 100% on SWE-Proof. This reward leads every other training signal we compare, including a binary pass-or-fail reward trained under otherwise identical settings, with the widest margin on code generation. When the agent must also deliver the repository patch, graded by each project's withheld tests, the fraction of held-out issues it resolves rises from 59.6% to 72.5%. Evaluated unchanged on three verification suites withheld from training, the checkpoints improve on all of them, including one whose language and verifier are absent from training.
items.summary_zh: 该方法把程序验证器的诊断信息转成强化学习奖励，并通过完整性审计防止篡改规格或假设待证明结论。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 DafnyBench、SWE-Proof 及未见验证套件上报告留出验证率，直接检验“通过测试”与“满足形式规格”的差异。
items.abstract_zh: 代码强化学习通常奖励通过测试，但模型可能在未覆盖的输入上仍然错误。程序验证器则判断程序是否对所有输入满足形式规格。语言模型几乎总是在推理时才与验证器配对，而将验证器转成奖励会面临两个困难：它只报告接受或拒绝，当所有尝试都失败时没有梯度；并且策略可能欺骗验证器，最简单的方式就是指示验证器假设本应由证明建立的结论。我们构建了一个 agent 环境和奖励来应对这两个问题。该奖励读取验证器的诊断信息，而不是最终判定；它按已解除证明义务的加权比例为候选打分，并结合来自参考证明注释的隐藏探针。完整性审计的优先级高于验证器：如果候选修改了规格或假设了本应证明的内容，就会被拒绝。模型作为 agent 与实时验证器进行多轮交互，并配有一个单独训练、冻结的证明专家协作者。在 Qwen3 1.7B 至 14B 模型以及 35B Qwen3.6 混合专家模型上，代码生成的留出验证率在 DafnyBench 上从 66.1% 提升到 93.5%，在 SWE-Proof 上从 56.3% 提升到 100%。在其他训练信号中，包括在其他条件相同下训练的二元通过/失败奖励，该奖励均取得最好结果；其在代码生成上的优势最大。当 agent 还必须提交仓库补丁，并由每个项目的隐藏测试评分时，解决留出问题的比例从 59.6% 提高到 72.5%。在训练中未使用的三个验证套件上直接评估时，检查点在三者上均有改进，其中包括一个训练中未出现过其语言和验证器的套件。
items.author_line: George Ma, Yuhao Zhang, Bing He, Zeren Shui, Ferhat Erata, Murali Krishna Ramanathan, Somayeh Sojoudi, Hao Zhou

items.title: @r_de_santi：We’re bringing natural-language control to any scientific generator. We are very excited to introduce LLM-to-Flow Distil
items.abstract_or_text: We’re bringing natural-language control to any scientific generator. We are very excited to introduce LLM-to-Flow Distillation (LFD), a method to adapt scientific generators to high-level natural-language discovery goals. Starting from textual goals like “design peptides with promising anticancer activity” or “design small molecules binding to the D2 dopamine receptor”, LFD distills high-level goal-related knowledge from LLMs into scientific generators through iterative DPO on LLM-generated sub-goals. 🔥 LFD does not need task-specific proxy rewards, works with any frontier LLM via API-access, and outperforms state-of-the-art reward-guided methods such as FlowGRPO and DiffusionNFT on held-out computational evaluations. (1/6)
items.summary_zh: 作者介绍 LLM-to-Flow Distillation（LFD）：通过迭代式 DPO，把前沿大模型从自然语言发现目标中提炼出的子目标知识注入科学生成器，并报告其在留出计算评测中超过 FlowGRPO、DiffusionNFT。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 事实：帖文给出方法机制、示例目标和比较对象。作者观点：LFD 可适配任何可通过 API 访问的前沿 LLM，且无需任务特定代理奖励。编辑判断：若论文和评测细节可核查，这对自然语言驱动的分子/肽设计具有直接参考价值。
items.abstract_zh: 我们正在为任何科学生成器带来自然语言控制。我们很高兴介绍 LLM-to-Flow Distillation（LFD），一种将科学生成器适配到高层次自然语言发现目标的方法。从“设计具有潜在抗癌活性的肽”或“设计结合 D2 多巴胺受体的小分子”等文本目标出发，LFD 通过对由 LLM 生成的子目标进行迭代式 DPO，将与高层目标相关的知识蒸馏到科学生成器中。LFD 不需要任务特定的代理奖励，可通过 API 访问与任何前沿 LLM 配合使用，并在留出计算评测中优于 FlowGRPO 和 DiffusionNFT 等最先进的奖励引导方法。（1/6）

items.title: @AnimaAnandkumar：Excited to share ReRoute, our new framework for scientific counterfactual prediction: informed by partial physics knowle
items.abstract_or_text: Excited to share ReRoute, our new framework for scientific counterfactual prediction: informed by partial physics knowledge for much better generalization. 🌍 AI models can be remarkably accurate on familiar data, yet struggle with scientific ‘what-if’ questions The key idea: Combine observational data with partial physical knowledge to predict unseen interventions—without requiring new controlled experiments. Instead of retraining models on expensive new simulations, ReRoute uses known partial physical mechanisms to guide pretrained models through lightweight fine-tuning on existing data. The results: 🌍 Up to 31.8% lower prediction error under severe CO₂ distribution shifts in climate emulators. 🔬 Up to 89.6% lower counterfactual error in controlled advection–diffusion experiments. ⚡ No new intervention data. No retraining from scratch. Just lightweight fine-tuning. We also establish a causal identification result under explicit structural assumptions, with a machine-checked proof in Lean.
items.summary_zh: Anima Anandkumar 介绍 ReRoute：把观测数据与部分物理知识结合，用轻量微调预测未见过的干预情形；帖文报告气候模拟器误差最多降低31.8%、受控平流–扩散实验反事实误差最多降低89.6%，并给出 Lean 机器检查证明。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 事实：帖文列出方法、实验场景和误差变化。作者观点：部分机制知识可以避免重新训练或新增干预数据。编辑判断：这是将因果识别、物理先验和科学机器学习结合的清晰研究信号，但具体基准仍需查阅论文核实。
items.abstract_zh: 很高兴分享 ReRoute，我们用于科学反事实预测的新框架；它利用部分物理知识来实现更好的泛化。AI 模型在熟悉数据上可能非常准确，但面对科学领域的“如果……会怎样”问题时却会遇到困难。核心思路是：结合观测数据与部分物理知识，在不需要新的受控实验的情况下预测未见过的干预。ReRoute 不必在昂贵的新模拟上从头重新训练模型，而是利用已知的部分物理机制，在现有数据上对预训练模型进行轻量微调。结果是：在气候模拟器的严重 CO₂ 分布偏移下，预测误差最多降低 31.8%；在受控平流–扩散实验中，反事实误差最多降低 89.6%。不需要新的干预数据，也不需要从头重新训练，只需轻量微调。我们还在明确的结构假设下建立了一个因果识别结果，并用 Lean 对证明进行了机器检查。
items.author_line: Prof. Anima Anandkumar

items.title: @parmita：AlphaFold was trained on about 170,000 protein structures, plus public sequence databases. The compute was roughly 100 t
items.abstract_or_text: AlphaFold was trained on about 170,000 protein structures, plus public sequence databases. The compute was roughly 100 to 200 GPUs for a few weeks. The compute was the cheap part. Every one of those structures was solved in a lab, one protein at a time. They sit in an archive called the Protein Data Bank. It opened in 1971 with 7 structures and holds over 200,000 now! AlphaFold scored 92.4 out of 100 on that exam in 2020. Year 49 of the archive. Year 26 of the exam. The AI was the last few weeks of a 50 year measurement project!
items.summary_zh: 帖文用 AlphaFold 说明：模型训练只用了数周 GPU 计算，但其训练基础来自 Protein Data Bank 数十年的实验结构积累；作者强调，AI 成果依赖长期测量基础设施。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 事实：作者列出约17万蛋白结构、100–200块 GPU、PDB 的历史规模和 AlphaFold 2020 年得分。作者观点：计算本身是便宜部分，实验测量档案才是关键基础。编辑判断：这为讨论科学 AI 的数据与实验基础提供了有信息量的历史视角。
items.abstract_zh: AlphaFold 使用了大约 170,000 个蛋白质结构以及公共序列数据库进行训练。计算量大约是 100 到 200 块 GPU、持续数周。计算是便宜的部分。那些结构中的每一个，都是在实验室里一次测定一个蛋白质得到的。它们存放在一个名为 Protein Data Bank 的档案库中。该档案库于 1971 年开放，当时只有 7 个结构，如今已有超过 200,000 个！AlphaFold 在 2020 年的那场考试中得分 92.4（满分 100）。档案库成立第 49 年，考试第 26 年。AI 所用的只是这项 50 年测量工程的最后几周！

With iFixAi you can have this answer in less than 120 seconds. · Topics: agent-evaluation, ai, ai-alignment, ai-evaluation, ai-governance, ai-safety, cli, diagnostic-tool, eu-ai-act, hallucination-detection, iso-42001, llm-evaluation, llm-security, nist-ai-rmf, owasp-llm, prompt-injection, python, responsible-ai, risk-assessment, risk-management
items.summary_zh: iFixAi 提供独立审计 AI 代理的命令行工具，检查代理是否按预期工作，并覆盖幻觉、提示注入、治理和风险评估等主题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 项目把代理评测和治理要求落到可执行审计流程，适合关注可靠性与合规的团队；“120秒内完成”是仓库自述，不能视为通用性能保证。
items.abstract_zh: Independent Auditing of AI Agents：可由人或代理自身运行，回答代理是否按预期工作的审计问题，并声称可在120秒内给出结果。
